title: AI-Enabled Creative Director (US-Based)
description:
As an
**AI-Enabled Creative Director**
, you will turn complex business challenges into compelling creative ideas while making AI an essential part of how creative work is developed and delivered.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, shape creative direction, and confidently sell ideas to clients. Beyond using AI tools yourself, you will build and apply practical workflows that expand creative possibilities, improve production efficiency, and help your teams deliver exceptional work.

This role calls for both strong creative leadership and hands-on AI expertise. You know how to inspire people, make confident creative decisions, and use emerging technology to elevate the work without compromising originality, strategy, or quality.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.

**Why this role exists**

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.

With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.

We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.

This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.

**What you will be doing**

* **Set the creative vision**
  – Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and disciplines, translating business objectives into compelling concepts, campaigns, brand identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Sell and champion creative ideas**
  – Present concepts with confidence, articulate the strategy behind your recommendations, and build buy-in from both clients and creative teams. Navigate objections assertively and constructively while protecting the integrity of the work.
* **Build and implement AI-enabled workflows**
  – Develop practical workflows for your client projects, combining AI tools to streamline asset creation, refinement, and production. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution.
* **Expand creative possibilities through AI**
  – Use AI to explore new directions, challenge conventional approaches, and develop stronger creative solutions. Apply the technology where it adds meaningful value, not simply because it is available.
* **Lead and mentor multidisciplinary creatives**
  – Provide clear direction, actionable feedback, and support to designers, writers, motion specialists, and other creative professionals. Help teams strengthen their craft and incorporate AI effectively into their work.
* **Own the creative lifecycle**
  – Stay involved from the initial brief through final delivery, overseeing execution and quality control. Ensure every asset meets the highest standards of strategic relevance, originality, brand consistency, and production quality.
* **Collaborate closely with Creative Project Managers (CPMs)**
  – Partner with your CPM to align priorities, navigate feedback, and support smooth project execution while maintaining ownership of creative direction and outcomes.
* **Anticipate and resolve challenges**
  – Proactively identify creative or client issues, make confident decisions, and find solutions independently. Take responsibility for keeping creative work moving without relying on managerial escalation.

**What you will bring**

* **Around 8 years of relevant creative experience**
  , including at least
  **2 years in creative leadership and 2 years of hands-on experience applying AI to creative workflows**
  .
* **An outstanding creative portfolio with strong AI-enabled samples**
  , demonstrating strategic thinking, originality, and high-quality execution across creative disciplines. You can clearly explain your role, creative decisions, and the impact of AI on the final work.
* **Proven experience developing and implementing AI-powered creative workflows**
  , combining technologies such as Higgsfield, Weavy, or comparable tools to enhance creative development and production. Your expertise goes beyond basic prompting or isolated AI-generated assets.
* **A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving**
  , with the confidence to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and independently resolve creative or client issues without waiting for direction.
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
  , with the ability to balance competing priorities, identify inconsistencies, maintain brand standards, and deliver high-quality work across multiple projects.
* **Assertive, persuasive communication skills**
  , with a demonstrated ability to pitch and sell creative ideas, defend recommendations, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment among both clients and creative teams.
* **Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary creatives**
  , providing decisive direction, constructive feedback, and the motivation needed to bring ambitious ideas to life.
* **Strong creative and strategic judgment**
  , grounded in branding, storytelling, art direction, design, and audience-centered communication, with an understanding of responsible AI use and the importance of human oversight.
* **Experience managing a high volume and variety of creative deliverables**
  across multiple clients, brands, or products in fast-paced agency or in-house environments.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with the adaptability, reliability, and strong internet connection needed to succeed in a remote environment

**How we work**

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection.

You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.

Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.

**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**
You will operate autonomously without a Head of Department managing your day-to-day creative decisions or resolving routine client challenges on your behalf. We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.

**What this role offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.

**We believe great teams are built on shared values:**

* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.

**Success in this role means:**

* Delivering original, strategically strong creative work across multiple client accounts, maintaining exceptional quality from concept through final execution.
* Making AI a practical part of creative production by implementing workflows that expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.
* Building trust and alignment with clients and creatives through persuasive presentations, confident leadership, and clear creative direction.
* Proactively resolving challenges, managing priorities independently, and maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Elevating team performance through effective mentorship, practical AI adoption, and consistently high creative standards.

**Disclaimer:**

**When applying, please include an updated portfolio showcasing the work you would like us to consider, along with relevant project links, supporting work, or samples of AI Creative Workflows.**

**For collaborative projects, clearly specify your contribution and the areas you were responsible for.**

Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.

Be cautious when applying. Official communications from Designity will come only from the Designity.com domain.

At Designity, employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences; it’s what makes our team and our work stronger.

title: Design Director
description:
Design Directors lead the creative heart of a project, from early ideas to final delivery. You’ll set the vision, guide designers and writers through execution, and bring clarity and perspective to every stage of the work. You’re someone who can turn strategy into concepts, concepts into systems, and systems into beautiful, functional design, while helping the team and our clients see where an idea can go. You have a sharp eye for craft, communicate clearly and generously, and stay curious about new tools and where design is headed.
  
  
At Rudy, everyone designs, directors included. Staying hands-on is how we stay sharp, stay current and keep our work honest. Design Directors are leaders, collaborators and co-authors who move easily between making the work and guiding it. You’ll lead brands built from scratch, refreshes of established ones, and work that brings clarity to complex challenges across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints. You’re confident making creative calls and know how to bring out the best in the people around you.
  
  
We’re looking for unique talent: people who take creative risks, have a real appetite for experimentation, and are excited to push what’s possible, with past work that shows it. You’re curious, culturally tuned-in, and drawn to work that has both conceptual depth and visual ambition.
  
  
**This Role Will Have You**

* Lead design and creative direction across brand identity, systems, campaigns, digital, print and everything in between
* Design hands-on alongside the team, from early explorations to final craft
* Guide designers, writers and interns from exploration through execution, with clear direction and feedback
* Shape strategy into creative: turn research and messy inputs into compelling concepts and clear directions
* Partner with studio leadership, strategists, technologists and collaborators to bring ideas to life
* Shape and share the work with clients, building trust and bringing them along on the thinking
* Champion experimentation, AI-enhanced workflows and non-linear exploration, and push the work into new territory
* Hold a high bar for detail, quality and conceptual integrity across every project
* Mentor the team and help foster a studio culture of critique, generosity and play

**You Might Be a Great Fit If**

* You have 8+ years of experience in branding, digital design or adjacent creative fields, including leading projects
* You still love to make things, and you have a hard time imagining not designing
* You have mastery of the fundamentals – layout, type, hierarchy, storytelling – and more importantly, can teach them
* You take smart risks and are energized by ideas that haven’t been tried yet
* You love the big swing and the tiny detail, and know which one a project needs
* You have range: you can lead identity, digital and campaign work without losing clarity
* You give feedback that makes work and people better, and welcome it in return
* You value craft, but you’re not precious – you iterate, explore and evolve until the work sings

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience directing motion, 3D or illustration
* Fluency in Figma, AI workflows, prototyping tools and modern digital design practices
* Interest in culture, ideas, technology and the future of what creative studios can be

**Compensation And Benefits**

* Salary: $110 - $130k, plus quarterly profit sharing and performance bonuses
* 401(k) retirement plan
* 3 weeks paid vacation, plus paid sick days
* Two-week studio closure at the end of the year, plus culture-forward holidays
* Medical, dental and vision insurance, with premiums covered for individuals
* Complimentary access to wellness and mental health services
* Life insurance
* Annual company retreat
* 2 weeks a year to work from any time zone
* 6 Learning Days a year
* One design event, festival or conference a year, on us
* Pre-tax commuter benefits and FSA

This is a hybrid role based in our Chinatown, NYC studio. We have a strong preference for NYC-based candidates, but are open to remote for the right person, working East Coast hours.
  
  
Email us your portfolio, resume and a note on why you’d like to join us – and include ‘Design Director’ as the subject line: jobs@ru-dy.com

title: Creative Director, Filmmaker for Brand Storytelling
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.**Roku is changing how the world watches TV**

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

The Creative Director/Filmmaker — Brand Storytelling leads the concept, development, and production of Roku-produced brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and other high-impact brand films within the Creative Studio. This is a hands-on creative leadership role for an exceptional storyteller who can find the simple, ownable, and entertaining idea, shape compelling narratives within the world of Roku City, and guide the creative vision from first pitch through post-production. You will turn brand and business objectives into entertaining, visually distinctive work that strengthens Roku's cultural relevance, recognition, and audience connection. The role requires both creative ambition and practical fluency across editorial, animation, visual effects, sound, color, and finishing. You will lead stories that can be funny, surprising, emotional, or all three—using comedy, character, visual invention, live-action sensibility, animation, and emerging production techniques. This role partners closely with an AI-assisted, in-house production team to establish creative standards, develop treatments and scripts, direct development, and bring the work to life with speed, flexibility, and craft. You will be accountable for ensuring work is high-quality, on-brand, emotionally resonant, and delivered efficiently across campaigns, products, and global markets.

For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $209,400 - $232,800.

Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.

This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

* Lead end-to-end creative development of Roku Creative Studio brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and related brand storytelling—from brief and insight through concept, treatment, script, visual development, production, post-production, and final delivery
* Define the creative point of view for each project, establishing the story, tone, visual language, comedic approach, performance direction, pacing, sound, and craft standards
* Write, develop, or collaborate on scripts, treatments, storyboards, beat sheets, visual references, and production plans
* Direct the creative process across live-action-inspired, animation, visual effects, motion, and AI-assisted video approaches—identifying when each technique best serves the story
* Lead an in-house production model using AI-assisted and agentic workflows, maintaining a high bar for originality, quality, brand integrity, and responsible use of AI
* Collaborate with Brand Strategy, Copy, Marketing, Product, Devices, Advertising, and other cross-functional partners to translate business objectives into audience-first stories
* Present concepts and creative recommendations to senior stakeholders, building alignment while protecting the strength and distinctiveness of the work
* Champion a culture of experimentation, candor, generosity, humor, and creative excellence within the team
* Build and maintain relationships with select external creative, production, talent, and finishing partners when specialized support is needed
* Establish and evolve a portfolio of Roku brand storytelling that scales across campaigns, products, experiences, and global markets

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

* 10+ years of experience as a video creative director, filmmaker, director, or equivalent creative leader in a brand, agency, entertainment, studio, network, or production environment
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in commercial filmmaking and visual storytelling, including brand films, commercials, idents, experience videos, or other high-impact video work
* Demonstrated ability to develop an idea from a brief into a clear, compelling concept and carry it through pre-production, production, and post-production workflows
* Exceptional visual storytelling skills, with a sharp eye for composition, camera, performance, pacing, production design, motion, sound, and editorial rhythm
* Experience creating comedy-driven work, including strong premise, character, timing, tone, surprise, and emotional payoff
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams of producers, editors, animators, designers, writers, technical artists, and production partners
* Ability to give clear, actionable feedback and inspire excellent work without creating unnecessary process or friction
* Comfort working in an evolving, AI-assisted production environment with genuine interest in agentic creative workflows and emerging approaches to filmmaking
* Sound judgment around the responsible use of AI, including originality, rights, likeness, representation, confidentiality, and brand safety
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex creative choices simple and persuasive for a range of stakeholders
* A collaborative leadership style and a positive, creative team dynamic
* Experience with AI-assisted video tools, virtual production, procedural workflows, or AI-assisted editorial, animation, and visual effects is highly valued
* Experience developing global brand work and adapting stories across markets, formats, and cultural contexts
* A strong understanding of the streaming ecosystem and the role that simplicity and delight play in the customer experience
* A portfolio or reel showcasing commercial, visual storytelling, comedy, and animation work (please include links and passwords, if applicable)
* Bachelor's and/or master's degree in film, communications, design, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience

**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

**What are some of the benefits?**

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

**Accommodations**

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

**What should I know about Roku's culture?**

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: Director, AI Creative (Remote)
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
  
  
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
  
  
Forbes Advisor is hiring a Director, AI Creative to design and implement how the Creative team uses AI to improve the quality and the quantity of our work across our social verticals. As this is a new department within the Creative team, you will define its function, build the systems that run it, and hire and oversee the required team. The ideal candidate has deep expertise spanning generative AI and tooling, direct response creative, and leadership of creative teams. You and your team will work across Forbes’ portfolio of verticals, partnering with Creative Directors who own end-to-end vertical creative strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design the strategy, team structure, and systems for embedding AI tools in the creative process, with a focus on producing a high volume of generative AI content designed for paid social creative.
* Own generative output end to end for paid social and native: stills that hold the same character across every shot, AI video, lip-sync, and generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to organized, tagged, editor-ready footage. Set the quality bar for generated work and enforce it.
* Architect the systems that make generation scale past any one person: pipelines, prompt libraries, character reference libraries, internal tooling, and the automation that connects them.
* Measure how well AI content, and the systems that produce it, are working. What a finished asset costs to make, how long a job takes from approved script to editor handoff, how often work is accepted on the first pass, and how generated work performs in market against everything else we run.
* Help raise the AI fluency of the whole creative team. Work with Creative Directors and their teams to design AI-enabled tools, systems, processes that improve quality and quantity of output.

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in creative, production, or content, with at least the last 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production. You have stood up an AI capability inside a creative org before.
* A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built, and you can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished.
* Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted work that ran as paid creative, with an honest account of what you made versus what the model made, and how it performed. You can hold character and continuity across a whole spot, work out why a render broke instead of re-rolling blindly, and get work through platform filters yourself.
* Deep, current fluency with the generative tools: image models that can hold several characters consistent, AI video both with and without native audio, lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on the trade-offs, not a list of tool names.
* You architect the tooling. You can map out the systems and automations the team needs, build working versions yourself in tools like n8n, Gumloop, or Make, and brief engineering clearly enough that they can build the rest.
* Experience leading people or a function, whether as a manager, a team lead, or the person who built a capability others came to depend on. You can make the case for a hire and then hold the bar you set.
* Comfort working inside compliance rails: regulated-category claims, platform ad policy, and partner brand guardrails.
* Clear written communication, and the confidence to hold your position with senior people outside Creative, including the buyers and the executive team.
* Comfortable in a start-up style operating environment where the tools, and sometimes the plan, change under you.

****STRONG PLUSES****

* Video editing or motion and VFX background (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci) that lets you hand editors better material and speak their language.
* Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project-management tooling.
* Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in-platform reporting) to close the loop between what rendered and what converted.
* A track record of forming a real point of view on brand-new tools fast, because these tools turn over monthly.

title: Associate Creative Director, Performance
description:
**About Sequencing**  
Sequencing is the world’s largest direct-to-consumer whole genome sequencing platform, helping define the future of AI-powered personalized health.

We’re a Series A venture-backed, fully remote company turning clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into meaningful, personalized insights. Through AI and a growing ecosystem of genomic applications, we’re building the trusted home for every genome.

In 2026, GenomeWeb named Sequencing a Best Places to Work winner, highlighting our fully remote culture of autonomy, transparency, and growth. As our COO, Shara Birn, put it: “We hire talented people, give them meaningful responsibility, and trust them to make decisions.”

**About the Role**

Sequencing.com turns clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into a lifelong source of personalized health insights, from everyday wellness questions to serious health decisions. We're rebuilding how that story looks, sounds, and performs, and we need an Associate Creative Director to lead it.

You'll define the new brand and make it earn its keep in paid channels. You'll work side by side with our product designers and agencies so the brand shows up in the product as clearly as it does in an ad. You report to marketing leadership and partner with growth, lifecycle, product marketing, and product design. This is a hands-on seat for someone who wants to ship, not just direct.

**What You'll Own**

* **The rebrand, end to end.** Lead our visual identity, voice, and creative language from concept through rollout across web, product, paid, and lifecycle.
* **Performance creative that works.** Concept, make, and iterate high-performing ads across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, CTV, and emerging AI-native channels. You live in the metrics and know why a creative won.
* **Partnership with product designers.** Work shoulder to shoulder with product design so the brand and the experience feel like one thing, from first ad to in-app moments to subscription flows.
* **Stories people trust.** Turn complex genomic data into clear, emotional, scientifically responsible stories that help people understand their genome and act on it.
* **Creative systems that scale.** Build templates, modular assets, and guidelines across acquisition, engagement, retention, and subscription so the team ships faster without losing quality.
* **Fast learning loops.** Run rapid experiments, read the results with growth, and turn what you learn into the next round.
* **A high, consistent bar.** Guide internal teammates, freelancers, and agencies, and stay close to the craft yourself: art direction, writing, design, motion, prototyping, and production.

**Who You Are**

* 8+ years in creative roles, with 2+ years leading creative or owning a brand at a startup or growth-stage company.
* Proven experience leading or driving a rebrand, ideally at an earlier-stage company where you built the identity and the system, not just applied one.
* A portfolio of performance creative with real results on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or CTV in consumer subscription, DTC, wellness, or tech. You can show the numbers behind the work.
* Hands-on craft in design, video, motion, and creative strategy.
* A track record of working closely with product designers to bring a brand into the product experience.
* Solid digital marketing instincts: funnels, testing, attribution basics, and how creative drives acquisition and retention.
* You use AI tools every day for image, video, motion, copy, and ideation, and can show how they've made your work faster and better.
* Staying power. We value people who commit and grow in a role, so a history of multi-year tenures stands out.
* High ownership and autonomy in a fast-paced, fully remote environment. Experience leading teams, freelancers, and agencies is expected.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in wellness, healthtech, biotech, or another category where trust and science matter.
* Familiarity with design tools your product designers use (Figma) and comfort prototyping in them.
* Experience with lifecycle and subscription creative, such as email, onboarding, and win-back.

**Why Sequencing?**

For decades, the human genome has been one of the richest health information in the world, but most people have never been able to truly understand or use it. We’re changing that.

We're transforming billions of genetic variants and decades of scientific research into technology people can interact with naturally and trust. This isn't another health app. It's a new category that brings together bioinformatics, genetics, and consumer health.

**Your work won’t just help build Sequencing. It will help redefine how people understand themselves through their DNA for decades to come.**

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Paid volunteer time off
* Fully remote work, with equipment provided and internet and cell reimbursements
* Parental bonding leave
* Private, confidential clinical-grade whole genome sequencing for you and your immediate family

*Join us in helping build the interface between humanity and its DNA!*

title: Creative Director (Organic Social)
description:
Marriage Reset is on a mission to save one million marriages. Our coaching programs help men rebuild their relationships and become better husbands. More than 7500 clients have enrolled, and our content has generated millions of views across social platforms.

We are hiring a Creative Director to take full ownership of our organic social department. Paid media currently drives most of our client acquisition. We want to build a stronger organic presence that earns trust in the brand and consistently generates qualified inbound calls.

Instagram is our main growth priority. You will be responsible for the content strategy and creative standards across all our organic channels, with the autonomy to lead the department and accountability for its performance.

**The role**

You will work directly with Josh Hudson, our co-founder and main spokesperson, to develop the brand’s organic content strategy. You will plan several months ahead, establish the monthly content agenda, and direct the work from initial concept to final approval.

Your responsibilities include developing content angles, writing scripts in Josh’s voice, and preparing recording briefs. You will run a content waterfall that turns long-form recordings into content tailored to each platform, with a consistent production and publishing schedule.

You will manage and develop the editors and copywriters, review their work, and take responsibility for the quality of everything we publish. You will also work with the wider marketing team to maintain a consistent brand across our digital presence.

Performance analysis will guide the strategy. Across all organic channels, you will assess audience growth and content performance, then work with sales to understand the contribution to qualified enquiries and booked calls. You will use that evidence to set priorities and improve results.

We expect you to take initiative, make informed creative decisions and lead the department without close supervision.

**Requirements**

* **Proven organic social growth |** A track record of growing an account for a founder, brand or yourself, supported by starting and ending audience figures, a clear timeframe and evidence of your personal contribution.
* **Strategic content leadership |** Experience developing content strategies over several months, directing production and adapting the plan based on performance. You must be able to connect day-to-day creative decisions to the wider business objectives.
* **Advanced copywriting and scriptwriting |** Strong command of hooks, storytelling and copywriting frameworks, with the ability to translate a founder’s expertise into compelling content that retains their voice.
* **Content waterfall implementation |** Experience building and managing a repeatable system for turning long-form recordings into short-form video and other content adapted to different platforms.
* **Management of both video editors and copywriters |** Direct experience setting briefs, reviewing scripts and edits, coaching team members, and holding them accountable for quality and deadlines.
* **Practical AI experience |** Experience integrating AI into content production or editing workflows, with editorial oversight to protect accuracy, quality, and brand voice.
* **Excellent written and spoken English |** The ability to write persuasive, natural copy for an English-speaking audience and communicate precise creative direction.

**Preferred experience**

We place particular weight on substantial growth achieved for a founder’s account, especially on Instagram. Candidates with strong results from their own accounts or other brands will also be considered.

* **Significant audience growth |** Adding around 100,000 followers to another person’s account, or growing your own account to that size, is highly valued. This is a preference, not a minimum eligibility requirement.
* **Coaching industry experience |** Experience in any coaching specialty is an advantage. We also consider candidates from other industries who meet the core requirements.
* **YouTube or other long-form audience growth |** A record of building an audience through long-form content.
* **Commercial results |** A demonstrable contribution to multimillion-dollar sales, with a clear understanding of how that contribution was measured.

**Working arrangement**

* This is a fully remote engagement under an independent contractor agreement, requiring a full-time commitment. The compensation package includes a base salary plus performance incentives linked to sales.
* Time zone and core working hours: EST/PST

**Applications**

* ***Please apply only if you meet the required criteria and can provide evidence of your experience. Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be progressed.***
* Applications must be submitted through this job posting or our website. Please do not send applications or follow-up enquiries by direct message.
* Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within ***one to two weeks*** of applying. If you have not heard from us within two weeks, your application has not been shortlisted.

*Thank you for your interest in Marriage Reset!*

title: Creative Director
description:
Matchnode is a performance agency built for digital health. Our clients grow on qualified patients, completed appointments and revenue. In a category where every brand promises “personalized care: and “a provider today”, the work that wins says something no one else is saying, in a way people believe.

The Creative Director sets Matchnode’s creative point of view and leads the team that brings it to life. You’ll push briefs past the obvious and bring clients ideas that make them nervous and excited. You’ll show our clients why these ideas are worth pursuing using performance data, category insights and culture.

You’ll partner with Accounts and Paid Media as a business leader, not a service function. Together you’ll share how our clients grow and how Matchnode wins new business.

This is a hands-on role but your real output is a team that thinks bigger, and clients who trust us with bigger ideas.

**Core Creative Leadership Responsibilities**

* Define the agency’s creative POV: What great digital health advertising and marketing looks like, and why ours is different from other competing agencies.
* Translate complex health services into clear, empathetic language that helps people understand their options and take an informed next step.
* Own creative strategy for paid social, with Meta and Instagram as core channels and TikTok, YouTube, and other paid channels as client needs require.
* Set the standard and tone for ideas, writing and craft across every account
* Bring cultural moments, platform shifts and category trends into the agency and the work before clients ask for them (or expect them)
* Push the briefs. Challenge the ask, the obvious angle until the problem is worth solving for.
* Turn audience insight, funnel data and competitive gaps into campaign platforms
* Own the creative roadmap with Paid Media, balancing big swings with iteration of proven sprint work.
* Carry winning ideas through to landing pages and conversion assets so the journey feels like one brand
* Build a culture where creatives feel inspired and connect creative to outcomes

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

**Creative & Production**
-------------------------

* Write and edit headlines, hooks, scripts and landing page copy, when needed.
* Direct statics, carousels, motion, short-form video, creator content (UGC), clinician explainers, demos, patient stories, etc.
* Make platform native work for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other channels as needed.

**Testing & Performance**
-------------------------

* Partner with Paid Media and Analytics to run a structured creative testing program. Define the hypothesis, audience insight, primary variable, and success criteria before production.
* Review performance at the concept, message, format, and asset level. Use attention and click metrics as diagnostic signals alongside conversion rate, cost per qualified acquisition, and downstream outcomes.
* Distinguish creative findings from changes in spend, targeting, landing pages, attribution, or patient intake. Avoid declaring winners from limited or misleading data.
* Turn results into clear recommendations: what to scale, what to revise, what to stop, and what to test next. Document learnings so they inform future work across the team.
* Monitor fatigue and maintain a steady pipeline of fresh concepts and useful variations that supports client growth.

**Client Collaboration & Team Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead creative discovery, concept presentations, and performance reviews. Explain the audience insight, creative rationale, and proposed test in language clients can evaluate.
* Partner with account management and paid media. Own creative recommendations, quality, and delivery.
* Coach internal creatives and external partners, set clear standards, and develop their ability to connect craft with measurable outcomes.
* Oversee briefing and creative process, feedback, approvals, workload, and production schedules across accounts. Flag scope changes and resource constraints early; deliver within agreed hours, budgets, and deadlines.
* Use AI and automation to support research synthesis, ideation, variations, and production where appropriate, with human review for accuracy, originality, brand fit, and sensitive content.
* Support new business and account growth through relevant concepts, case studies, and creative recommendations. Help leadership scope and price creative work realistically.

title: Creative Director
description:
**ABOUT STORD**
---------------

  

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

  

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

  

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

  

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About the Role
  
  
The Creative Director is the visual and conceptual voice of Stord. Reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, you will set the creative vision for how Stord looks, sounds, and feels across every channel, and lead the studio that brings it to life.
  
  
This role is for a hands-on creative leader who moves comfortably between big ideas and finished work. You have strong opinions about what great creative looks like, a portfolio that proves it, and the leadership skills to inspire a studio team and manage agency and freelance partners. You know that creative and performance work together, and you build campaigns that prove it for DTC founders, ecommerce leaders, and the broader commerce ecosystem.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Content, and Sales to make sure Stord's creative is consistent, differentiated, and commercially effective at every touchpoint.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Creative Vision & Brand Identity**

* Own Stord's creative vision, visual identity, and brand expression, keeping them consistent and distinctive across all channels and audiences
* Turn Stord's positioning into a clear visual language, voice, and point of view that resonates with mid-market DTC founders and ecommerce operators
* Act as the creative steward of the brand: set standards, educate the organization, and push for quality at every touchpoint
Partner with Product Marketing so creative ladders up to GTM messaging and positioning  

  

**Creative Studio Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop the in-house studio of designers, creatives, and content producers
* Set creative direction and review work across campaigns, sales collateral, web, events, and product marketing assets
* Build efficient creative processes (briefing, intake, review, and approvals) so the studio delivers high-quality work at the pace of a high-growth company
Manage agency and freelance relationships to scale output when needed  

  

**Campaigns & Content Creative**

* Develop big ideas and integrated campaign concepts that bring the brand to life across digital, video, social, events, and owned media
* Direct the creative for thought leadership, video, and editorial content that earns attention and builds brand affinity with DTC founders and ecommerce leaders
* Partner with Demand Generation and Sales to create work that drives pipeline, and use performance data to sharpen it
Make sure all creative reinforces Stord's position as the default operating system for modern commerce  

  

**Brand Experience & Visibility**

* Guide creative for major company moments, including product launches, partnerships, and executive announcements
* Support executive visibility and PR efforts with strong creative storytelling and polished visual assets
Collaborate with Communications and Content on a consistent narrative across press, social, and owned channels  

  

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 10+ years of progressive creative or marketing experience, with at least 4 years in a Creative Director or equivalent creative leadership role, ideally in VC-backed, high-growth B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services
* A strong portfolio showing concept-to-execution work across brand, digital, video, campaigns, and sales or product marketing assets
* Proven experience building or scaling a creative function from an early or underdeveloped state
* Deep fluency across creative direction, brand identity, design, and storytelling, with the judgment to operate at the strategic level without losing touch with craft
* Experience leading and developing in-house creative or studio teams, and the ability to attract, retain, and inspire A-players
* Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and production partners
* Comfort working as a player-coach: you set direction and hold a high bar, and you roll up your sleeves when the moment calls for it
Superior storytelling, presentation skills, and executive presence, with the ability to defend creative decisions and represent the brand with conviction  

  

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

* **Creative Vision:** Turns complex positioning into simple, memorable ideas and visual systems that connect to commercial outcomes
* **Builder's DNA:** Thrives in ambiguity; builds the processes, standards, and teams where none existed
* **Creative Rigor:** Holds a high bar for quality while moving at the speed of a high-growth business; knows when to ship and when to push
* **Cross-Functional Influence:** Earns trust with Marketing, Sales, Product, and executive stakeholders; drives alignment without relying on authority
* **Coaching & Talent Development:** Gives clear, constructive feedback and grows creative talent at every level
* **Customer Obsession:** Uses voice-of-customer insight to inform creative decisions and keeps the DTC founder and ecommerce operator at the center of the work
* **UX Ownership:** Brings deep understanding and empathy for the user experience and owns translating it into exceptional, engaging design

  

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* 10+ years of creative or marketing experience, including 4+ years leading creative direction in a high-growth B2B environment
* Experience managing and scaling an in-house creative or brand studio
* Demonstrated ability to deliver integrated campaigns that drive measurable business results
* Bachelor's degree in design, communications, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Bonus: prior experience in ecommerce SaaS, logistics, or commerce-adjacent technology

You will collaborate closely with creative leadership, producers, designers, content strategists, creative technologists, developers, and other multidisciplinary teams to align creative vision with experience design, technical feasibility, and production requirements. * Translate client objectives and audience needs into compelling, intuitive and engaging experiences.
* Shape user journeys, interaction models and experience principles, considering usability, accessibility and context.
* Identify opportunities to make experiences distinctive, meaningful and memorable.

#### **2. Creative & Art Direction**

* Direct visual design, motion, animation, content and storytelling to ensure a cohesive creative vision.

title: Art Director, Motion and Brand
description:
### **About PrePass**

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

### **About the Role**

The PrePass marketing team is tasked with expanding the PrePass brand. We are energized by the prospect of breaking ground in our field and making a positive impact within the transportation industry. We are looking for an Art Director, Motion and Brand, with strong design, motion, and animation fundamentals and a passion for visual storytelling. This person not only values great craftsmanship but also knows how to turn complex products and ideas into clear, compelling video and animation that share the PrePass story and purpose with our customers.

As the Art Director, Motion and Brand, you'll work with the Senior Art Director, the Director of Marketing Comms, and the larger Marketing team to bring the PrePass brand to life in motion. You'll own video and animated content for performance marketing campaigns, product launches, social, web, and events, with secondary responsibility for digital design across email, social, landing pages, and other channels. This role requires strong organizational and communication skills to manage multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables.

### **Essential Responsibilities**

### **Video, Motion, and Animation**

* Conceptualize, storyboard, and produce video and animated content for social, web, email, paid media, webinars, and trade show screens.
* Create product explainers, animated demos, and short-form videos that make complex solutions—toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety—easy to understand.
* Design and animate 2D motion graphics, kinetic typography, illustrated animation, and animated data visualizations.
* Edit and finish video from raw footage, including pacing, sound design, music selection, captioning, and color correction.
* Support video shoots, customer testimonials, and event coverage, from shot lists to final edit.
* Build animated brand elements, including logo animations, lower thirds, transitions, and title sequences.
* Develop motion guidelines and reusable templates that keep video and animated content consistent and on-brand.

### **Brand and Creative Support**

* Design marketing assets, including emails, social graphics, landing pages, web banners, and paid ads.
* Create supporting collateral and assets for campaigns and events, such as video thumbnails, ad variations, and presentation graphics.
* Extend the PrePass visual brand identity consistently across video, motion, and digital channels.
* Generate strong conceptual ideas aligned with strategic business goals.
* Clearly articulate creative rationale, concepts, and visual direction to key stakeholders.
* Contribute to all phases of the creative process: research, brainstorming, scripts, storyboards, animatics, style frames, and final production.

### **Collaboration and Tools**

* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional internal teams and external vendors.
* Use design and production tools such as Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, and Asana, along with generative AI tools such as Adobe Firefly and Google Flow, to speed up ideation and production.
* Prepare and optimize files for each channel, including aspect ratios, file sizes, and accessibility standards.

### **Project Execution**

* Manage day-to-day workflow while meeting deadlines across multiple initiatives.
* Support marketing events such as webinars, trade shows, and product launches with motion and design assets.
* Stay current on design, animation, and video trends and bring fresh ideas to the team.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Qualifications/Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in design, motion graphics, and animation, gained at an agency, startup, or in-house team.
* A portfolio and reel that showcase polished video editing, motion graphics, animation, and strong design fundamentals—including typography, layout, color, and composition.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, plus Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions through a strategic business lens.
* A self-starter who takes full ownership of design projects, both large and small.
* Strong prioritization skills with the ability to manage timelines across multiple initiatives.
* Based in the United States.

### **Bonus Points For**

* B2B marketing experience, especially translating technical products into clear visual stories.
* Experience with 3D tools (Cinema 4D, Blender), AI-assisted design and video tools, or Lottie/web animation.
* Knowledge of the transportation, logistics, or fleet management industry.
* Availability in Mountain Standard Time or West Coast time zones.
  

  
  
**Benefits**  

### **How We Will Take Care of You**

* Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
* Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
* 401(k) plan with employer match.
* Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).
* Tuition Reimbursement Program.
* Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.
* Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
* Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
* Community Give-Back initiatives.
* Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

**Join Us**

**At PrePass, our mission drives us.**

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

**Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.**

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Foundation**

Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when their buyers ask AI for solutions. We do it through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence across LLMs, search, Reddit, YouTube and the sources they draw on.

**Mission of the Role**

You own the quality bar for everything creative Foundation delivers: written content, design, video, and social and ad creative. You make sure the work clients get is clear, distinctive and built to be found and cited, and that every pod holds it to the same standard. Your job is making the work better and keeping it that way as we grow.

You work across all of our client teams. Each team is led by a Group AEO Marketing Director who owns a book of clients, with an AEO Program Director who runs delivery. Our writers, designers, editors and producers sit in those pods. The Head of Paid Media, the Head of Organic & AI Visibility and their leads set the standard for their channels. You hold the creative bar across all of them.

**Reports to:** Head of Client Services. Direct reports: creative makers not yet placed in pods. Dotted line: the writers, designers, editors and producers in every pod and through our freelance partners.

**What you'll own:**

* The quality gate. You design the creative quality check every piece goes through before it reaches a client: the criteria, the checklists, and who runs it in each pod. Pods run the check day to day. You review a sample of work each week, handle escalations, and personally review high-stakes work, such as a new client’s first deliverables. Work that isn’t ready goes back with feedback the maker can act on.
* The creative standard. You set and document what great looks like at Foundation: guidelines, examples, storytelling and brand frameworks, and the checklists the gate uses.
* Your team. You manage and develop the creative makers who aren't yet placed in pods. The resource manager staffs them across pods. When each pod can keep one busy, they move into pods and stay on your dotted line.
* Creative hiring. You run the technical skill assessment part of every creative hire and have a veto on creative quality.
* Creative levelling. You define what each level of writer, designer, editor and producer looks like, and give input on their promotions.
* Coaching. You give the people who make the work regular, specific feedback, train them, and close skills gaps across pods.
* AI in the creative workflow. You build and roll out AI tools and workflows that raise quality and speed, and make sure AI-assisted work still meets the bar.
* Partners and freelancers. You make sure third-party creators and editors meet the same standard as our own team.

**What you bring:**

  

* 8+ years in creative leadership for B2B brands, in an agency or in-house, with a portfolio across writing, design and video.
* You've built a quality system before: standards, review gates and feedback loops that held up as volume grew.
* You make the call. You hold the bar under deadline pressure and say no when work isn't ready, without needing someone more senior to back you.
* You've already built things with AI: agents, tools or workflows you use in real creative work, and you can show us how you built them. Hands-on time with tools like Claude, Figma, Higgsfield, HeyGen or ElevenLabs counts. If you haven't built with AI yet, this role isn't the right fit right now.
* Experience teaching others: you've made writers, designers and editors better, including people who don't report to you.
* A clear point of view on what makes content get found and cited by AI assistants, and how that changes the creative brief.

**Position Details:**

Full-time (Monday to Friday, ~40 hours/week), Full Remote

Target Location: Canada, USA

Compensation: Base salary 110k–135k depending on experience and location

Variable compensation: Target 10% of base, tied to KPIs

Where you land in the range depends on experience. US ranges may be adjusted for cost of labor in your state. Benefits are on top of base.

The platform has successfully launched and is now actively adding new clients offering a unique opportunity for a dynamic, creative leader with bright, modern ideas and deep chops in brand design to help build the identity of one of the fastest-growing areas of the organization
  
  
The Creative Director - Design (Enterprise Marketing) will deliver innovative design and creative direction that prioritize innovation while balancing business goals with brand integrity. They will be a culturally savvy self-starter and systems-thinker who uses data and insights to create compelling, conversion-focused work that positions us as a leader in digital-forward business banking.
  
  
Initially, this position will lead and execute design and creative leadership within a small, discreet startup team, working directly with leadership, and aligning with Creative Studio executive leaders at regular intervals to ensure holistic brand alignment.
  
  
While entrepreneurial in spirit, this is not a ground-floor build from scratch. The platform is established, operating in market, and supported by an expanding Enterprise Marketing organization. The Creative Director will partner closely with an existing designer and writer who support the platform's marketing efforts, providing creative guidance and direction while benefiting from the broader capabilities and resources of the Enterprise Marketing team.
  
  
Primary Function
  

* Act as a leader in the creative visioning, stewardship, and hands-on design of the platform’s brand and its marketing approach.
* Deliver creative strategy and design of brand assets, guidelines, and marketing campaigns that will strengthen client trust and drive measurable results across digital, print, physical, and in-person experiences.
* Collaborate with performance marketing teams and other organizations to optimize creative for ROI, conversion, and sustainment.
* Leverage client insights, campaign performance data, and market learnings to evolve the brand and create increasingly effective client experiences as the business scales.

Leadership and Team Development
  

* Provide creative leadership and mentorship across a designer and writer while fostering strong collaboration with performance marketing, content, strategy, and enterprise creative partners. (more may be added)
* Regularly connect with and seek direction from Creative Studio.
* Act as an evangelist for the platform’s brand and its application throughout the enterprise.
* Demonstrate expert level skills in design tools, methodologies, and production processes, and coach junior members toward the same, fostering a culture of excellence.
* Establish creative workflows that enhance efficiency and productivity.
* Maintain an extensive network of creative resources for freelance and recruiting. Help shape the future growth of the platform's creative capabilities as the organization continues to expand.

Brand Building and Stewardship
  

* Establish robust brand identity systems that work across many channels, ensuring quality and brand integrity across all touchpoints.
* Balance innovative approaches with regulatory requirements and financial industry standards.
* Develop creative solutions that resonate with small business owners and business decision- makers, helping strengthen client trust and differentiate the brand in a competitive digital banking landscape.

Data-Driven Innovation
  

* Use performance data and testing insights to refine creative strategies.
* Track and forecast marketing trends, technologies, and best practices.

Vendor and Partner Collaboration
  

* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders, external agencies, and production vendors to ensure quality and cost efficiency.
* Maintain a knowledge of regulatory requirements and ensure application of best practices to avoid risk for the organization and ensure clarity for clients.
* Operate with organizational savvy in a collaborative, productive manner.
* Partner effectively across a matrixed organization, influencing stakeholders and building alignment while maintaining speed and creative excellence.

QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Bachelor's degree or master's degree in design and minimum 8 years of experience in graphic design, interactive, advertising, media, UX, and/or related fields.
* Strong visual, written, and oral presentation skills
* Preferred: experience in banking, fintech, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
* Preferred: experience developing creative and marketing programs that support small business acquisition, engagement, and growth.
* E xperience building brands in growth-stage environments is highly valued.
* A combination of education and experience may meet job requirements

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION
  
This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $115,000 - $175,000 annually depending on job-related factors such as level of experience and location.
  
  
This opportunity can be located across the Zions Bancorporation Footprint or 100% remote within the United States.
  
  

* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance start day one
* Life and Disability Insurance, Paid Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance
* Health Savings (HSA), Flexible Spending (FSA), and dependent care accounts
* Paid Training, Paid Time Off (PTO) and 11 Paid Federal Holidays, and any applicable state holidays
* 401(k) plan with company match, Profit Sharing, competitive compensation in line with work experience
* Mental health benefits including coaching and therapy sessions
* Tuition Reimbursement for qualifying employees enrolled in an accredited degree program related to the needs of the business, maximum of $5,250 per calendar year, employees are eligible for the program upon hire
* Employee Ambassador preferred banking products
