**Job Title:** Art Director, Brand & Design  
**Location:** Remote  
**Reports to:** Director of Brand Marketing  
**Status:** Full-Time  
**Salary Range:** $110,000-$130,000  
**Direct Reports:** Graphic Designers

**About Bask & Lather Co.**

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, family-founded haircare brand dedicated to restoring crowns and confidence. What began as a kitchen remedy has evolved into one of the most celebrated textured-hair care brands in the U.S., loved for our authentic story, transformative results, and community-first approach.

It’s an exciting time to join our team as we grow and build a culture rooted in creativity, collaboration, and care. Together, we’re shaping the next chapter of a brand powered by community and led by purpose to help people everywhere love their hair, love their journey, and love themselves.

**Role Overview**

Bask & Lather is seeking an Art Director, Brand & Design to bring our brand to life across campaigns, digital experiences, product packaging, retail displays, and experiential marketing.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a strong designer who can develop compelling concepts, personally execute key creative, and lead graphic designers to deliver cohesive, commercially effective work. You will translate brand strategy into clear visual direction and help build the systems, standards, and team capabilities needed to support a growing beauty brand.

Reporting to the Director of Brand Marketing, you will collaborate with Brand, Growth, E-Commerce, Retention, Retail, Experiential, Product Development, and Supply Chain to ensure creative builds brand recognition, communicates product value, and supports business goals.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Art Direction & Brand Design**

* Develop creative concepts and visual systems for integrated campaigns, product launches, and ongoing brand marketing.
* Translate approved brand strategy into clear art direction, design briefs, and cohesive execution across customer touchpoints.
* Maintain and evolve design standards, templates, and asset libraries within the brand’s established identity.
* Art direct photography, short-form video, creator content, and product demonstrations, including mood boards, composition, styling, and post-production guidance. Ensure clear product education and consistent brand presentation.

**Hands-On Creative Execution**

* Personally design key creative across e-commerce, social, email, paid media, marketplaces, sales materials, and brand campaigns.
* Develop platform-specific creative for TikTok Shop, paid and organic social, creator content, and livestream shopping, adapting storytelling and design to how customers discover and purchase on each channel.
* Translate customer questions, hair concerns, cultural insights, and relevant trends into creative that resonates with our audience and reflects the brand’s voice and standards.
* Partner with Growth, Social, E-Commerce, and the Director of Creative Performance to develop and refine creative using performance insights and customer feedback, supporting structured testing and iteration.

**Packaging, Retail & Experiential Design**

* Design packaging, labels, cartons, kits, and other physical brand materials from concept through production-ready artwork.
* Develop retail displays, merchandising assets, signage, and environmental graphics that translate the brand into physical spaces.
* Work with internal partners and external vendors on dielines, specifications, proofs, color, materials, and finishes.
* Ensure artwork includes approved content and completes the required cross-functional reviews before production.

**Team Leadership & Creative Operations**

* Manage, coach, and develop graphic designers, providing clear direction and constructive feedback.
* Prioritize projects, balance workloads, and maintain accountability for creative quality and deadlines.
* Review deliverables for brand consistency, accuracy, channel suitability, and production readiness.
* Build scalable workflows that improve turnaround time and reduce unnecessary revisions while maintaining high standards.

**Key KPIs & Success Metrics**

* A cohesive, recognizable brand across digital and physical touchpoints.
* Strong creative delivered accurately and on time.
* A design team with clear direction, useful feedback, and consistent standards.
* Packaging and displays that meet brand, retailer, and production requirements.
* Creative systems that support growth and improve team efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional brand design or creative experience, including experience leading designers and providing art direction.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating consumer brand campaigns, photography and short-form video art direction, creator content, packaging, and retail or physical brand experiences.
* Hands-on proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with strong typography, composition, layout, and image-editing skills.
* Practical knowledge of packaging and print production, including dielines, artwork preparation, color management, and proof review.
* Experience designing for e-commerce and digital marketing, with an understanding of how creative supports customer education and conversion.
* Strong judgment, organization, communication, and the ability to move projects forward independently.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to balance personal execution with effective delegation.
* Experience in beauty, haircare, skincare, wellness, or consumer packaged goods is strongly preferred. Experience supporting social commerce, particularly TikTok Shop, is strongly preferred. Ability to direct video and motion work is required; hands-on motion design or video editing is a plus.

**Why Join Bask & Lather Co.?**

* Be part of a passionate, fast-paced team changing the narrative around scalp care
* Play a pivotal role in a high-growth, high-impact brand with national reach
* Directly support strategic initiatives and help shape scalable infrastructure
* Competitive salary, collaborative culture, and room to grow with the business

**Benefits**

* Medical Insurance- (Health, Dental, Vision)
* Paid Time Off
* 401K
* Plum Benefits Discounts
* Career growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding company

**How to Apply**

Please include a portfolio with examples of digital campaigns, photography or short-form video art direction, creator content, packaging, and retail or physical brand design. Identify your personal design contribution, art direction, and team leadership on the work shown.

Bask & Lather Co. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We provide reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs.

title: Creative Director
description:
**Who We Are**

Robert Half, one of FORTUNE’s World’s Most Admired Companies and a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For is hiring for a **Creative Director** to join the Marketing department.

The Creative Director leads Robert Half's Brand Design Studio and is responsible for elevating the strategic thinking, concept development, visual identity system, design quality, and creative execution of Robert Half's marketing, communications, and brand experiences. This role translates brand and marketing strategies into compelling, effective creative work across channels while ensuring the studio continues to deliver high-quality creative services, production, and execution at scale.

The Creative Director owns the evolution, governance, implementation, and adoption of Robert Half's visual identity system in close partnership with Brand Marketing. This role leads a multidisciplinary creative team and partners with Brand Marketing, Integrated Marketing, Content Marketing, Field Marketing, Performance Marketing, Corporate Communications, Corporate Services, and external creative agencies to develop creative concepts, design systems, campaign assets, and production solutions that are strategically aligned, visually distinctive, and operationally achievable.

The Creative Director serves as the senior internal creative leader for major creative initiatives, including agency-led work when appropriate, ensuring creative output reflects Robert Half standards, supports business objectives, improves stakeholder confidence, and raises the overall creative maturity of the organization.

**What You'll Do**

**Creative Direction, Concept Development & Visual Identity Leadership**

* Establish and communicate the creative vision for Robert Half marketing, communications, and brand experiences, ensuring creative work balances strategic thinking with strong execution.
* Lead or guide development of creative concepts, campaign ideas, visual approaches, and design solutions that bring brand and marketing strategies to life across channels and touchpoints.
* Own the evolution, governance, implementation, and adoption of Robert Half's visual identity system in close partnership with Brand Marketing.
* Define and maintain design standards, visual frameworks, creative guidelines, and best practices that ensure consistency, flexibility, and scalability across customer and employee touchpoints.
* Lead the translation of brand strategy, messaging, and audience insights into distinctive visual expression across campaigns, content, communications, digital experiences, presentations, events, and customer-facing materials.
* Review and direct creative work to ensure high standards of quality, consistency, audience relevance, craftsmanship, effectiveness, and brand integrity.
* Serve as Robert Half's senior internal creative leader during major agency-led creative initiatives, ensuring work aligns with visual identity standards, business objectives, audience needs, and creative expectations.

**Marketing Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Brand Marketing, Integrated Marketing, Content Marketing, Field Marketing, Performance Marketing, Corporate Communications, Corporate Services, and business stakeholders to support marketing and communications objectives.
* Translate campaign briefs, messaging inputs, and audience insights into creative strategies, concepts, design approaches, production plans, and executional deliverables.

* Guide creative collaboration with external agencies, freelancers, production partners, and internal teams, ensuring the right work is produced by the right resource model.

* Foster a high-performance creative culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, constructive critique, curiosity, innovation, production excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Coach and inspire the team to elevate creative thinking, design quality, storytelling, execution standards, and overall creative output.

**Success Measures**

* Improved creative quality, concept development, visual storytelling, and design craftsmanship.
* Consistent adoption and application of Robert Half visual identity standards across major touchpoints.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and confidence in creative partnership, quality, and delivery.
* Effective creative support for integrated marketing, content marketing, communications, events, internal initiatives, and digital experiences.
* On-time delivery, improved project cycle time, resource utilization, and production efficiency.
* Successful collaboration with external agencies, freelancers, vendors, and production partners when appropriate.
* Growth in team capability, employee engagement, talent development, and creative maturity.

**What You'll Need**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in creative, design, advertising, creative services, or brand-related roles.
* 7+ years leading creative teams, agencies, studios, or design organizations.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams responsible for both concept development and production delivery.
* Experience owning or leading visual identity systems, design standards, design systems, or creative guidelines.
* Experience developing integrated creative concepts and production-ready creative across digital, social, web, presentation, event, campaign, video, motion, and print channels.
* Experience partnering with brand, marketing, communications, content, digital, UX, production, agency, and business stakeholders.

* Creative services production leadership.

* Creative operations and resource management.
* Agency, freelance, vendor, and production partner management.
* Team leadership, coaching, and talent development.

title: Associate Creative Director
description:
World Vision is hiring an Associate Creative Director to serve in the Marketing Division.
  
  
AT A GLANCE
  
**Role:** Associate Creative Director
  
**Reports to:** Senior Creative Director
  
**Location:** Remote
  
**Required Experience:** In addition to education or equivalent experience, requires at least 8 years of progressively responsible creative experience. Experience in an advertising agency or a high-performing in-house creative team is required.
  
**Preferred Experience:** Prior people-management experience is preferred. Experience with digital-first marketing, direct response, testing and optimization, and responsible use of AI-enabled creative tools is strongly preferred.
  
**Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S.A for any employer.
  
**Travel:** Up to 10% of the time.
  
**Estimated hiring range:** 104,200 - 151,590
  
  
THE JOB
  
Lead creative development, storytelling, and brand expression within World Vision’s internal advertising agency. Partner with senior leadership to translate fundraising and audience strategies into integrated, multichannel campaigns, with an emphasis on writing and messaging. Guide assigned team members, set priorities, and oversee quality and delivery to strengthen brand awareness and produce measurable results. Carry out World Vision’s Christian mission, vision, and strategies, witnessing to Christ and ministering to others through life, deed, word and sign.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* Keep Christ central in individual and corporate life. Actively participate in and contribute to the spiritual disciplines of the organization (Christian conduct, chapel, prayer, worship, devotions and leadership of devotions); incorporate WV Core Values into decisions within scope of role.
* Lead assigned brand and fundraising campaigns from strategic brief through final delivery, translating audience insight and organizational objectives into integrated creative concepts, messaging, and multichannel experiences.
* Serve as the lead creative and conceptual partner for assigned work, developing campaign narratives, concepts, messaging frameworks, calls to action, and creative solutions across direct response, digital, social, video, experiential, print, email, web, and emerging platforms.
* Establish project-level creative direction, goals, priorities, and quality expectations for assigned writers, designers, freelance partners, and cross-disciplinary teams; monitor progress and resolve difficult but typically non-complex execution, resource, and stakeholder issues.
* Review work in progress and final deliverables for strategic alignment, brand voice, creative quality, accuracy, accessibility, channel requirements, budget, and timelines; provide clear, actionable feedback and approve work within delegated authority.
* Partner with peers, the Senior Creative Director, and cross-functional partners to clarify briefs, align expectations, allocate resources, and deliver cohesive creative solutions.
* Present creative concepts and rationale to clients and senior stakeholders, synthesize feedback, and guide the team toward effective solutions.
* Supervise assigned professional employees and creative personnel, including setting goals and objectives, assigning work, coaching performance, supporting development, and contributing to talent decisions.
* Support a client-centric in-house agency model through strong service standards, collaboration, processes, and consistent policies.
* Use performance data, audience feedback, testing results, and emerging tools to improve work.
* Maintain awareness of corporate goals, objectives, organizational announcements, and activities. Reference and follow organizational policies and procedures, seeking clarity as needed.

YOU BRING THESE SKILLS
  

* Creative thinking, storytelling, concept development, and strong oral and written communication, including fluent English and persuasive messaging that motivates donors and prospects.
* Advanced marketing and branding knowledge and graphic design fundamentals, supported by fundraising knowledge and an understanding of global events and World Vision’s mission and priorities.
* Strategic orientation and planning: Translating organizational goals into creative strategies and practical short- and long-range plans across work units.
* Implementation and project management: build production plans, identify resources, balance competing priorities, and manage milestones, costs, and delivery.
* Team building, people management, collaboration, and relationship building set clear expectations, develop team members, and build strong internal and external partnerships.
* Customer-focused solution design, initiative, adaptability, and quality orientation: respond to changing needs, solve problems proactively, and improve processes and creative work.

REQUIREMENTS
  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (8 years). In addition to education or equivalent experience, requires at least 8 years of progressively responsible creative experience. Experience in an advertising agency or a high-performing in-house creative team is required. Prior people-management experience is preferred. A portfolio demonstrating strong creative thinking, concept development, and campaign effectiveness is required. Experience with digital-first marketing, direct response, testing and optimization, and responsible use of AI-enabled creative tools is strongly preferred.
  
  
SALARY & BENEFITS
  
**WVUS Pay Grade Level:** 228
  
**Estimated hiring range:** 104,200 - 151,590
  
  
The posted hiring salary range reflects pay for U.S. locations and is determined using market data and internal compensation guidelines. Actual compensation may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, and applicable laws. For information about World Vision U.S' comprehensive benefits package, please visit this link.
  
  
ABOUT WORLD VISION
  
We're a global Christian humanitarian organization. We partner with children, families, and their communities to empower them as they reach their full potential by tackling the causes of poverty and injustice. For 75 years, World Vision has followed Jesus' example to show unconditional love to the poor and oppressed. We serve every child regardless of faith.
  
  
**L.I.F.E. LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:**  
The LIFE Leadership Competencies provide a shared framework for Christ-centered leadership at World Vision. They define the skills, behaviors, and character qualities that help leaders lead faithfully and effectively, shaping how we hire, develop, and evaluate leaders to cultivate thriving teams and greater Kingdom impact.
  
  

* Love: How we show up every day, every interaction. Loving others the way Jesus loves—with humility, care, and grace-filled truth. We build trust. We model life with God. And we create environments where people feel seen, valued, and supported, because we see the image of our God in each of them.
* Ignite: How we unlock and catalyze. To Ignite is to unlock purpose, passion, and potential—so people can bring their best in service of children and donors. We build healthy, thriving teams and develop character, competence, and courage.
* Fulfill: How We Deliver. To Fulfill is to focus on what matters most—and deliver with excellence and accountability. We own outcomes. We prioritize mission-critical work. And we partner with God to produce results that advance Kingdom impact.
* Envision: How we change and evolve towards ‘Better’. To Envision is to lead boldly into the future—discerning what’s ahead with faith, navigating complexity, and casting vision that leads to lasting impact.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?
  
Due to the high volume of applications, only short-listed candidates will be contacted for an initial phone conversation with a recruiter. Please include a link to a creative portfolio or website. We also encourage you to submit a PDF resume and a cover letter. Our goal is to fill this vacancy with the right person in the shortest amount of time.

title: Robotics Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

**The role**
------------

As a Robotics Mechancial Engineer, you will play a key role in the design and development of our robots. You will be responsible for creating robust and efficient mechanical mechanisms, assemblies, and systems that integrate with advanced robotic technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, bringing together expertise in mechanical, electrical, and software engineering.

**The day-to-day**
------------------

* Design and develop mechanisms, systems, and electromechanical assemblies for robotic applications, including structures, actuators, and motion systems.
* Collaborate closely with the electrical and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of mechanical designs into complete robotic systems.
* Prototype, test, and iterate on mechanical designs to meet performance, cost, and manufacturability requirements.
* Analyze project specifications, materials, and manufacturing methods to ensure that designs meet both functional and production objectives.
* Use CAD tools (SolidWorks) to create detailed designs, 3D models, and engineering drawings.
* Participate in design reviews, contributing innovative solutions and improvements.
* Conduct simulations, stress analysis, and FEA to ensure reliability, durability, and safety of the designs.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting during product development and manufacturing processes.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in robotics and mechanical design to incorporate cutting-edge technologies into our products.

**You should apply if you**
---------------------------

* Hold a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (Master's preferred).
* Have demonstrated of experience in mechanical design, preferably in robotics or automation.
* Are proficiency with CAD software (ideally SolidWorks).
* Have a strong understanding of mechanical principles, including statics, dynamics, and material properties.
* Have experience with FEA, simulations, and mechanical stress analysis tools.
* Have hands-on experience with prototyping and testing.
* Are familiar with manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal manufacturing and injection molding.
* Have excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and within a team.
* Have strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
* Have experience with robotics, automation, or mechatronics systems is highly desirable.

**Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

* Helsing's work is important. You'll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn't work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Competitive salary** and **VSOP options**
* **Relocation support**: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation
* **Learning**: €500/£450 yearly allowance
* **Health & wellness**: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)
* **Social**: regular company events and monthly social allowances
* **Enhanced parental leave**: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers
* **Family support:** 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work
* A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled "Infraduction"), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one (Specifically for engineering and AI)

*These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.*

title: Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe
description:
**About the Role**

Teach For All is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to support a diverse group of network and prospective partner organizations in the Europe region and to lead regional work on public sector partnerships. As a Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe, you will steward Teach For All's engagement with a group of partner organizations in the Europe region, working to build and deepen relationships and collaboration in pursuing educational equity in Europe. In this role you will act as a strategic advisor to partner organizations, diagnosing needs and opportunities, consulting on strategic challenges, and mobilizing network resources to drive collective impact

In this position, you will also play a critical role in strengthening partner organizations'public sector partnerships through targeted support around institutional relations strategy development and execution in key countries in Europe. You will work closely with global team members to build more active partner connections and collaboration with their governments (Ministries of Education at national, regional or local levels; regional and local authorities; Universities and research institutions), by developing specific partner support initiatives, contributing to Erasmus+ projects, and designing learning experiences and ad-hoc resources when needed. The ideal candidate for this position will have a proven ability to work effectively across diverse contexts and cultures, navigating ambiguity with ease, and will have experience making sound strategic decisions that drive impact in complex and changing environments.

This role provides an exceptional opportunity for an individual with superior leadership, strategic, interpersonal, and programmatic skills to increase the impact of our mission and shape the education landscape in the region. The strongest candidates will have a proven ability to set a clear vision, build culture and relationships, influence outcomes through others, and make strategic decisions that drive meaningful impact. A strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is essential.

The ideal candidate will have a deep familiarity of living and working in Europe, must reside and be authorized to work in the region, speak English and ideally one additional regional language. The Director- Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe will report to the Head of Partner Engagement & Program - Europe and work closely with the Head of Region, Europe on external positioning and advocacy.

**Outcomes**

* Regional partner organizations are highly engaged with each other and the network and are dedicated to our mission and values, and to contributing to progress towards Teach For All's vision and intended outcomes, as measured by the annual network survey.
* Partner organizations in the region are better supported to develop and implement new, innovative and forward looking public sector partnerships that enable them to scale their programmes and increase their impact in the education system.
* There is growth in aggregate progress across the region, as demonstrated by relevant measures for the intended outcomes:

* Our network is expanding in the region.
* Collective leadership is strengthening within the communities and countries of network partners.
* Students in our classrooms are developing holistically as leaders who can shape a better future.
* Our network staff members, teachers, and alumni are a deeply interconnected, learning regional and global community.
* Insights from our network inform the regional understanding of what will drive progress for marginalized children.
* Strengthened relationships with regional program stakeholders in the region generating new opportunities for impact and influence. Support the growing impact of alumni in the region as leaders in schools and the education ecosystem.

**Key responsibilities:**

Partner Support (40%)

* As a "portfolio lead," serve as the primary day-to-day relationship holder with a portfolio of current and prospective partner organization CEOs, cultivating relationships to build positive, long-term partnerships as a means to achieving shared and mutually beneficial goals and outcomes.
* Co-create and manage the implementation of an annual partnership plan with each organization in the Network Engagement Director's portfolio, identifying how Teach For All will support them and how they will contribute back to the network on an ongoing basis. This plan will include the strategic engagement of other colleagues, teams and resources from across Teach For All.
* Share insights, ask thoughtful questions, and provide support to partner and prospective partner organization CEOs and their leadership teams, to build their capacity, advance strategic clarity and impact, and foster learning and sharing across the network, in line with Teach For All's shared global vision and priorities.

Public Sector Support (50 %)

* Work directly with CEOs and Head of Institutional Relationships in each partner organization to develop strong public sector strategies and action plans to identify new champions in government and identify new ways of partnering with the public sector to increase their ability to scale their programmes and increase their impact by leveraging regional, national and multinational opportunities
* Leveraging deep understanding of the educational landscape, develop and execute on strategies that build external champions and elevate awareness of our programmatic work in Ministries of Education and Ministries of Labour and Social Welfare, Regional and Local governments, and Universities across the region.
* Continue to build more capacity across the region, in both partner organizations and Teach For All to develop and manage stronger public sector relationships in pursuit of sustainability and scale of our work in Europe
* Facilitate meaningful learning experiences for partner organizations in the region, virtual and in-person when possible, such as immersive experiences and peer-to-peer visits for network partner organizations and emerging social entrepreneurs, fostering collaboration, culture, and connection in line with our broader network vision and values.
* Lead initiatives and strategies on region wide and global priorities to contribute to progress against our network intended outcomes.
* Co-build public sector partnership collaboration and learning across the region and globally.
* Support leadership development of key stakeholders in the region from alumni and senior partner staff through coaching and leadership development experiences

Contribute to Teach For All globally (10%)

* Work with the other global teams to contribute to global priorities and initiatives in particular in relation to our leadership development and program strategies
* Represent the global organization as needed at external opportunities

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience & Track Record: Minimum 10 years of professional experience, including demonstrable success leading senior-level public sector partnerships and navigating complex government or education systems across Europe.
* Contextual & Geographic Mastery: Deep familiarity with living and working within the European sociopolitical landscape, with current legal authorization to live and work long-term in an eligible hiring country.
* Strategic Systems Thinking: Proven ability to analyze educational landscapes, navigate bureaucratic systems, and design actionable public partnership strategies that achieve scale and sustainability.
* Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional interpersonal and political acumen, with a track record of building trusted relationships with senior leaders, government ministers, and diverse community stakeholders.
* Adaptive Leadership: Demonstrated experience navigating ambiguity, leading through influence across matrixed and cross-border teams without formal authority, and making sound decisions in complex environments.
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: Demonstrated commitment to DEI principles, with deep self-awareness and the ability to navigate racial, cultural, ideological, and power dynamics across countries.
* Linguistic Capability: Professional fluency in written and spoken English, paired with strong, professional-level communication skills.

**Additional Desirable Skills / Experiences**

* Fluency or professional working proficiency in French or an additional European language.
* Direct professional experience working inside schools, school networks, or national education ministries.
* Formal executive or leadership coaching experience supporting senior executives and social entrepreneurs.
* Prior hands-on experience designing or managing EU-funded programs (e.g., Erasmus+ projects).
* Familiarity with the Teach For All network model and theory of systemic change.

**What Teach For All Offers:**

* Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization's progress
* Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
* Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
* Generous time off and flexible work arrangements

* And much more!

**Application Instructions**

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Therefore, candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

Work authorization

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

**Compensation**

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

**Travel and Hours**

All work is delivered virtually. Up to 30% of travel may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

**About Teach For All**

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations' under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All's global organization works to increase the network's impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

title: Process Automation Engineer
location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, CN, Spain
description:
##### ***-******Las Palmas De Gran Canaria******-***

**Alien Technology Transfer** empowers top-class innovators to transform visionary product concepts into commercial realities. We do this by helping companies with concrete growth ambitions to secure funding for their product development through our innovation consulting expertise. To date, we have raised more than $700 million for our clients - Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) - across many domains, including agri-tech, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, clean-tech, cyber-security, quantum computing, space, and transport.

We’re looking for a versatile **Process Automation Engineer** to join Alien Technology Transfer at **our office in Las Palmas**. Working closely with and reporting directly to our CEO, you will play a central role in a company-wide review of how each of our departments operates. Your job is to understand how work actually gets done, identify where time, quality and effort are being lost, and then design, build and maintain the tools that fix it. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role that combines process analysis with full-stack engineering. You will spend time with department heads and their teams to map workflows and pinpoint inefficiencies. You will turn your findings into standardised processes and reliable software that is easily adopted. We are not looking for a specialist in a single layer, nor for someone who only writes code to a specification. We need a strong generalist who can diagnose a business problem, decide what should be standardised, automated or eliminated, and then deliver a working solution end-to-end.

To join our team, you must possess a genuine interest in technology and business, be fluent in English, and take a highly analytical, articulate, and well-organised approach to your work. We are seeking a self-motivated team player with a strong startup attitude and the stamina to thrive within an ambitious, goal-driven environment. The ideal candidate is eager to take on high levels of responsibility, possesses sharp problem-solving skills, and is proactive about staying up to date on the latest tools — AI or otherwise — to ensure top performance. You are energised by wearing multiple hats—effectively managing priorities and diverse deliverables autonomously without needing a detailed playbook. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact in this dynamic role, we would be excited to hear from you.

* **Contract Type:** Permanent.
* **Hybrid Work Modality:** Monday to Thursday at the Office (Las Canteras area) and Friday Work from Home.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

Process Diagnosis & Standardisation

* Work with each department to map current workflows and understand how work is actually done.
* Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, duplicated effort, error-prone manual steps and activities that add little value, and quantify their impact where possible.
* Define standardised processes, templates and quality checks that reduce variability and prevent quality issues before they reach clients.
* Present findings and recommendations to the CEO and department heads, and prioritise improvements by impact and effort.

Tool Development & Platform Engineering

* Design, build and maintain internal tools and applications that enhance the performance of each department, from data layer through to API and user interface.
* Integrate tools with the systems our teams already use, such as Google Workspace, Odoo, and other AI-powered tools, so that solutions fit naturally into existing workflows usable by department personnel.
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and keep internal tools documented and easy to hand over.

Infrastructure & Deployment

* Set up, maintain, and improve our deployment pipelines, infrastructure, and environments.
* Handle the operational side of running the platform: CI/CD, monitoring, and keeping things stable and secure.

Adoption & Continuous Improvement

* Support teams in adopting new tools and processes through clear documentation, training and hands-on support.
* Define and track metrics that show whether each change is improving department performance, and iterate based on results and user feedback.
* Continuously identify new opportunities for standardisation and automation as the business evolves.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable full-stack breadth.
* Strong backend engineering skills, with proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM or other AI/ML-based solutions.
* Proven ability to analyse business processes and translate them into practical software or automation solutions.
* Ability to translate user needs into clear UI/UX requirements (user flows, screens, states, edge cases) and to evaluate and refine interfaces until they are intuitive for non-technical users.
* Practical experience with infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, cloud environments, containerisation).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work with non-technical colleagues, understand their needs, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable owning a problem from diagnosis through to a deployed, maintained solution.
* Fluency in English (C1/C2 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with AWS or Google Cloud.
* Experience building AI tools that work with documents, such as searching, summarising, extracting or checking text (e.g. RAG, vector databases, NLP).
* Experience with Google Workspace APIs and workflow-automation platforms (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make).
* Knowledge of process-improvement methods such as Lean, Six Sigma or business process mapping.
* Experience in consultancy or professional-services environments, particularly in document-heavy work such as proposal or report writing.

**What We Offer**

title: Marketing Manager - Hotel Arts Barcelona
description:
**Additional Information**  
**Job Number**26145995  
**Job Category**Sales & Marketing  
**Location**Marina 19-21, Barcelona Barce 8005, Spain  
**Schedule**Full Time  
**Located Remotely?**N  
**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and implementing marketing strategies and plans that drive revenue and support the hotel's business objectives. This role oversees the execution of marketing initiatives, including digital marketing, advertising, public relations, social media, promotions and collateral, ensuring alignment with brand standards and commercial priorities.

The Marketing Manager is committed to bringing to life a distinctive luxury boutique hotel shaped by arts, creativity and curiosity. From its distinctive suites to its singularly designed restaurants, bars, spaces and experiences unfolding across a dedicated floor, every touchpoint presents an opportunity to provoke, inspire and indulge, revealing a new expression of Barcelona through a oneiric, enigmatic and cosmopolitan lens.

The role is committed to elevating every touchpoint to its fullest potential, curating a world that feels mythic and mysterious, protecting the concept's secrets and integrity, and embodying the spirit of a gracious host throughout every space, communication and encounter. Deeply connected to local culture and its artistic excellences, the Marketing Manager ensures that every expression of the hotel remains distinctive, meaningful and authentic.

The Marketing Manager supports the Director of Marketing & Communications in translating the hotel's marketing strategy and positioning into effective plans, campaigns and day-to-day execution. The role is hands-on and highly transversal, partnering closely with hotel departments and external agencies to ensure consistency, creativity and excellence across every guest-facing touchpoint.

The position begins during the pre-opening phase, supporting the preparation and delivery of opening marketing initiatives, launch communications and brand-building activities, and continues into the hotel's ongoing operational marketing.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  

* High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in marketing, public relations, communications or related professional area.
* OR 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major; no work experience required.
* Experience in luxury hospitality, lifestyle brands or creative environments is highly valued.
* Strong project management, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Creative sensibility, editorial judgement and attention to detail; able to translate brand direction into compelling content and executions.
* Fluency in English is mandatory. Spanish is preferred; Catalan is valued.
* Proficiency in digital marketing platforms, social media, content management and common creative tools; Adobe Creative Suite knowledge is required.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Marketing & Digital**

  

* Develops and executes marketing plans and campaigns in alignment with the hotel's business objectives and brand standards.
* Coordinates the execution of marketing campaigns across Rooms, Suites, Food & Beverage and the hotel’s broader experiences, happenings and brand activations, ensuring appropriate messaging, creative assets, timelines and channel integration.
* Supports the Director of Marketing & Communications in translating strategic priorities into actionable campaign plans, briefs, calendars and deliverables.
* Coordinates digital marketing initiatives across the hotel's website, email marketing, paid media, search, CRM and relevant digital platforms, in collaboration with internal teams and agencies.
* Monitors campaign performance, digital results and relevant marketing KPIs; prepares reports and recommendations to optimise future activity.
* Ensures marketing content, offers and information are accurate, current and consistent across owned and third-party channels.

**Content Management & Storytelling**

  

* Manages the development, production, adaptation and distribution of marketing content and collateral.
* Coordinates photography, video, copywriting and creative production to support campaigns, hotel experiences, Rooms and Suites, Food & Beverage and brand storytelling.
* Ensures content reflects the hotel's distinctive positioning, creative universe, cultural references and tone of voice across all guest touchpoints.
* Maintains content calendars and supports the timely delivery of editorial, promotional and seasonal content.
* Collaborates with hotel departments to identify stories, experiences and moments that can be translated into compelling content.

**Partnerships, Public Relations & Media**

  

* Coordinates marketing and public relations activities with appointed agencies and relevant internal stakeholders.
* Supports the development and management of brand partnerships, cultural collaborations and creative relationships that reinforce the hotel's positioning.
* Coordinates media relations activity, press materials, media visits, hosting and follow-up in collaboration with PR agencies and hotel teams.
* Supports the preparation of press releases, media pitches, briefing documents, fact sheets and other communications materials.
* Maintains relationships with media, influencers, creators and relevant industry contacts, ensuring professional and consistent engagement.

**Outlet & Ancillary Marketing**

  

* Works closely with Food & Beverage and other operational teams to support outlet marketing, promotions, storytelling and commercial initiatives.
* Coordinates marketing activity for restaurants, bars and hotel experiences, ensuring each is presented in a way that strengthens the overall hotel positioning.
* Supports the development of campaigns, content and collateral for outlet launches, seasonal moments, special menus and signature experiences.
* Ensures consistency of messaging and visual identity across outlet communications and guest-facing materials.

**Social Media**

  

* Manages the hotel's social media channels and content calendar in line with brand standards and marketing priorities.
* Coordinates content creation, copywriting, community engagement, publishing and channel optimisation across relevant platforms.
* Identifies opportunities to amplify hotel stories, cultural moments, happenings, partnerships and guest experiences through social channels.
* Monitors social performance, audience engagement and relevant trends, providing regular reporting and insights.
* Ensures timely responses and appropriate escalation of guest comments, messages and online feedback.

**Creative Production & Graphic Design**

  

* Coordinates the creation and adaptation of marketing collateral, presentations, digital assets and guest-facing communications.
* Supports graphic design and artwork development, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and the hotel's visual identity.
* Liaises with creative agencies, photographers, videographers, printers and other suppliers to deliver high-quality work on brief, on time and within budget.
* Reviews proofs, copy, layouts and final assets for accuracy, consistency and quality.

**Brand Activations, Happenings & Experiences**

  

* Supports the planning and execution of brand activations, cultural happenings, creative collaborations, previews and launch moments.
* Coordinates marketing requirements, creative assets, communications, guest invitations and follow-up for activations and hotel happenings.
* Works cross-functionally with hotel departments and external partners to ensure each activation is coherent, distinctive and aligned with the hotel's brand universe.
* Captures and extends the impact of happenings and activations through content, social media, PR and post-event reporting.

**General**

  

* Maintains strong working relationships with hotel departments, corporate teams, agencies and external partners.
* Manages marketing timelines, project trackers, budgets, purchase orders and administrative requirements as assigned.
* Ensures all marketing activity complies with brand standards, Marriott policies and applicable legal requirements.
* Supports the Director of Marketing & Communications with presentations, reports, planning documents and other marketing-related projects.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**LANGUAGES**

  

* English: mandatory
* Spanish: preferred
* Catalan: valued

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**

Marriott International is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive, people-first culture. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.

Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

title: Director, Site Enablement Solutions
description:
Barcelona, Spain | Full time | Home-based | R1578075

  

**Director, Strategic Growth & Customer Partnerships.**
-------------------------------------------------------

  
  

IQVIA is changing an entire industry through inspired innovation. Our people make the difference. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and we look for talented people and give them meaningful work to do. Join IQVIA and help us drive healthcare forward.

**Job Overview**
----------------

  
  

IQVIA Site Enablement Solutions provides site-based clinical research support designed to help sponsors and research sites address capacity, enrolment, and study execution challenges. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Head of Site Enablement Solutions, the Director, Strategic Growth & Customer Partnerships will lead execution of the business growth strategy through strategic account planning, executive customer engagement, customer expansion, opportunity conversion, and commercialization of emerging capabilities.

  
  

This is an execution-focused commercial leadership role requiring deep expertise in site support, site augmentation, and site engagement. The Director will develop customer-specific solutions and creative commercial structures that balance customer needs with pricing, geographic reach, implementation requirements, and operational delivery feasibility. The role will be dedicated to Site Enablement Solutions and will work across Business Development, Operations, Delivery, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and Strategy to convert opportunities into sustainable, deliverable partnerships.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

  
  

* Lead strategic account planning and growth execution across priority customer relationships.
* Develop account-specific expansion plans across therapeutic areas, geographies, studies, and delivery models to increase adoption and support repeatable, multi-study growth.
* Convert study-level and country-level engagements into broader portfolio and enterprise relationships.
* Build and maintain executive customer relationships, stakeholder maps, sponsorship models, and governance approaches.
* Identify and advance competitive opportunities where IQVIA can differentiate through global reach, flexibility, integrated capabilities, and measurable customer outcomes.
* Lead the design of customized site support solutions and commercial structures that align customer requirements with operational feasibility and sustainable delivery.
* Partner with Business Development and account teams throughout opportunity qualification, solution development, proposal strategy, pricing, negotiation, and bid defense.
* Increase inclusion and penetration of site support solutions within Full Service opportunities, particularly programs where site capacity or enrolment risk is material.
* Create repeatable frameworks for account growth, opportunity follow-up, pipeline-to-revenue tracking, objection handling, and conversion discipline.
* Support competitive pricing approaches, quantified value assumptions, and commercially viable alternatives in collaboration with Finance, Strategy, and Delivery.
* Translate emerging capabilities into clear, customer-ready propositions, use cases, and integrated solution pathways.
* Strengthen value articulation through return-on-investment models, key performance indicator frameworks, case studies, proof points, and differentiated customer storytelling.
* Partner with Delivery and regional teams to incorporate country readiness, resource models, contracting, pricing, and implementation requirements into commercial planning.
* Capture customer and market feedback and translate insights into offering, process, technology, and geographic expansion priorities.
* Serve as a member of the Site Enablement Solutions leadership team and provide visible ownership of the growth agenda.
* Partner with customer-facing and operational leaders to strengthen account management maturity and commercial effectiveness.
* Establish disciplined account reviews, opportunity ownership, executive stakeholder mapping, and progress reporting against growth priorities.
* Provide coaching and subject matter guidance to colleagues supporting customer engagement and solution positioning.
* Initially operate as an individual contributor; the role may assume leadership of customer-aligned delivery resources as the operating model and business needs evolve.

**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

  
  

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare, life sciences, business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in clinical research, healthcare services, contract research organization services, site services, or a related life sciences environment.
* Demonstrated experience in strategic account management, customer partnerships, commercial growth, solution development, or business development.
* Demonstrated experience in site support, site augmentation, site engagement, enrolment acceleration, or related patient and site services.
* Experience designing and negotiating complex, customized service solutions that require alignment across commercial and operational stakeholders.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical research organizations.
* Experience working within global and highly matrixed organizations.

**Additional Skills:**
----------------------

  
  

* Deep understanding of clinical trial operations, research-site workflows, site capacity constraints, and sponsor decision-making.
* Strong commercial judgment and ability to balance customer value, competitive positioning, pricing, operational feasibility, and financial sustainability.
* Ability to convert strategic priorities into executable account plans and measurable actions.
* Executive-level communication, influencing, relationship management, and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead through influence across Business Development, Operations, Delivery, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and Strategy.
* Strong problem-solving, negotiation, organizational, and prioritization skills.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures, regions, and time zones, with strong command of English.
* Knowledge of global delivery models, resource sourcing, site contracting, and country activation considerations is preferred.
* Experience coaching or leading customer-facing teams is preferred.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights, and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

At IQVIA, we believe that diversity, inclusion, and belonging empower our mission to accelerate innovation for a healthier world. We create a culture of belonging by valuing the perspectives of all talented employees worldwide and providing them with the opportunity to power smarter healthcare for everyone, everywhere. When our talented employees bring their authentic selves and their diverse experiences to work, they enable us to accomplish extraordinary things. Multifaceted thought processes spark innovation. Multi-talented collaboration harnesses innovation to deliver superior outcomes. Likewise, as part of this culture, IQVIA is committed to ensuring effective equality between women and men, integrating it as a strategic principle in its corporate and human resources policies.

**Where you'll work**
---------------------

### **Home-based**

You’ll work remotely, with the flexibility to do your best work from home. Supported by collaborative tools and a global team, you’ll stay connected while enjoying the autonomy and balance that comes with a fully remote role.

  

**Culture**
-----------

Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

title: Coordinador/a de Producción y Administración de Festivales
description:
**¡Estamos contratando! Coordinador/a de Producción y Administración de Festivales**

**Sobre nosotros**

Somos Pablo y Laura, directores de tres proyectos con sede en Barcelona: **Experimental Photo Festival, Ágora School of Experimentation**, una escuela online internacional dedicada a la fotografía experimental, e **IPFA (International Photography Festivals Association)**. Desde hace más de siete años trabajamos para promover la fotografía experimental a través de exposiciones, talleres, festivales, programas educativos y redes internacionales.

**¿Te apasionan los festivales, la producción cultural, la gestión artística y hacer realidad proyectos creativos?** Experimental Photo Festival, Ágora e IPFA buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo en **Barcelona** a un/a **Coordinador/a de Producción y Administración de Festivales**.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia en producción cultural, gestión económica y subvenciones, capaz de coordinar diferentes proyectos simultáneamente y de combinar el trabajo de producción sobre el terreno con una gestión administrativa y financiera rigurosa.

El puesto combina tres grandes áreas de responsabilidad: la producción y programación del Experimental Photo Festival y nuestros espacios expositivos, la gestión económica y administrativa de la asociación, y la preparación, seguimiento y justificación de subvenciones públicas.

Trabajarás en un equipo pequeño e internacional, con un alto grado de autonomía y responsabilidad. Durante el año, gran parte del trabajo se centra en la planificación, los presupuestos y la gestión de financiación, mientras que los meses previos al festival y especialmente julio requieren una mayor implicación en la producción de actividades, exposiciones y eventos.

**Principales responsabilidades**

* **Producción de festivales y eventos:** Planificar y coordinar la producción del Experimental Photo Festival y otras actividades culturales, incluyendo presupuestos, calendarios, materiales, proveedores y logística en distintas sedes.
* **Programación y coordinación de actividades:** Organizar los calendarios de talleres, conferencias, exposiciones y encuentros, coordinando las necesidades de artistas, participantes, espacios y equipo para garantizar el correcto desarrollo de las actividades.
* **Producción de exposiciones y residencias:** Coordinar la producción, montaje y desmontaje de exposiciones en los espacios gestionados por la asociación, especialmente Experimental HUB y Espai Golfes, así como la logística de nuestra residencia artística internacional.
* **Coordinación de artistas y proveedores:** Mantener una comunicación fluida con artistas, instituciones, sedes y proveedores, gestionar sus necesidades y resolver incidencias durante la preparación y ejecución de los proyectos.
* **Gestión económica y presupuestaria:** Elaborar y controlar presupuestos por proyecto, realizar el seguimiento de ingresos y gastos, colaborar en las previsiones de tesorería y preparar informes económicos para la dirección y la junta de la asociación.
* **Contabilidad y administración financiera:** Gestionar facturas, pagos, registros de gastos y documentación contable, en coordinación con la gestoría externa, incluyendo el seguimiento de cierres contables y obligaciones administrativas.
* **Subvenciones y financiación pública:** Identificar convocatorias de financiación, preparar y presentar solicitudes, realizar su seguimiento y elaborar justificaciones técnicas y económicas, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos y el correcto reparto de gastos entre proyectos y subvenciones.
* **Gestión administrativa y documental:** Mantener actualizadas las bases de datos, hojas de cálculo, contratos, inventarios y documentación de los proyectos, garantizando una organización rigurosa y accesible de la información.
* **Coordinación general de proyectos:** Colaborar con la dirección y el equipo en la planificación anual y en la gestión cotidiana de Experimental Photo Festival, Ágora School of Experimentation e IPFA.

**Qué buscamos**

* **Experiencia profesional:** Al menos 2 años de experiencia en producción cultural, organización de festivales, eventos artísticos o proyectos culturales similares. Valoraremos especialmente trayectorias de entre 3 y 5 años que combinen producción con gestión económica y administrativa.
* **Experiencia en subvenciones:** Experiencia demostrable en la preparación, gestión y justificación de subvenciones públicas para proyectos culturales, especialmente en la documentación económica y administrativa.
* **Gestión económica:** Capacidad para elaborar y controlar presupuestos, hacer seguimiento de gastos, gestionar facturas y trabajar con documentación contable, preferiblemente en asociaciones o entidades culturales sin ánimo de lucro.
* **Excel avanzado:** Dominio de Excel para la elaboración de presupuestos, seguimiento económico, control de gastos, previsiones de tesorería y organización de bases de datos. Se valorará también el dominio de Google Sheets.
* **Idiomas:** Dominio del español, inglés de nivel B2 o superior y capacidad de trabajar por escrito en catalán, preferiblemente de nivel B2 o superior, para preparar documentación administrativa, solicitudes y justificaciones.
* **Organización y planificación:** Capacidad para coordinar calendarios complejos, gestionar varios proyectos simultáneamente y cumplir plazos administrativos y de producción.
* **Autonomía y resolución de problemas:** Persona proactiva, organizada, rigurosa y resolutiva, capaz de anticipar necesidades, tomar decisiones operativas y gestionar imprevistos con autonomía.
* **Comunicación y trabajo en equipo:** Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar con artistas, instituciones, proveedores y profesionales culturales de diferentes países.
* **Disponibilidad:** Residencia en Barcelona o posibilidad de incorporarse presencialmente, con disponibilidad para trabajar puntualmente en fines de semana y horarios especiales durante el festival.
* **Requisitos de contratación:** Disponer de autorización para trabajar legalmente en España.

**Valoraremos especialmente:**

* Experiencia trabajando con instituciones culturales públicas, asociaciones u organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro.
* Experiencia en la preparación o gestión de **subvenciones culturales, ayudas públicas y justificaciones económicas**.
* Conocimientos de **contabilidad básica, gestión presupuestaria y administración financiera**.
* Familiaridad con sistemas CRM y gestión de bases de datos.
* Interés por la fotografía, el arte contemporáneo y las prácticas artísticas experimentales.
* Formación en gestión cultural, producción de eventos, administración o disciplinas relacionadas.

**Qué ofrecemos**

**Lugar de trabajo:** Centre Cívic Pati Llimona, Barcelona

**Salario:** 1.550 € netos al mes, aproximadamente 23.000 € brutos anuales, coste anual para la asociación, 30.500 €

**Contrato indefinido** después de un periodo de prueba de 3 meses

**Jornada completa:** 35 horas semanales

**Trabajo híbrido:** 4 días presenciales en la oficina y 1 día de teletrabajo

**22 días de vacaciones**

La oportunidad de trabajar con una comunidad internacional de artistas, comisarios, profesionales de la cultura y festivales de fotografía.

Un entorno de trabajo creativo y colaborativo, donde participarás directamente en la organización de un festival internacional de fotografía experimental y otros proyectos culturales y educativos.

Si te apasiona la producción cultural, disfrutas de hacer que las ideas se conviertan en realidad y te gustaría formar parte de una comunidad creativa internacional en crecimiento, **¡nos encantará conocerte!**

**Para presentar tu candidatura, envíanos tu CV y carta de motivación por correo electrónico a:** **hola@experimentalphotofestival.com**

**¡Conoce más sobre nosotros!**

**Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/experimentalphotofestival/**

**Página web: https://www.experimentalphotofestival.com/**

Sueldo: A partir de 23.000,00€ al año

title: KAM Senior
description:

Buscamos un/a **Key Account Manager (KAM) Senior** para liderar nuestra expansión en el canal moderno en España. Una oportunidad para construir, con mucha autonomía, el siguiente capítulo de una marca que está cambiando las reglas de la categoría.

* Abrir nuevas cuentas y conseguir la entrada en nuevos lineales, así como ampliar referencias y cuota de lineal en las cuentas existentes.
* Preparar presentaciones para compradores apoyadas en datos de mercado para demostrar potencial de ventas y distribución.

**Requisitos**

* Mínimo **4 años de experiencia como KAM** (o rol equivalente) en **productos de droguería / limpieza del hogar en canal moderno**.
* Conocimiento del sector y relación con compradores de cadenas de supermercados e hipermercados en España.
* Experiencia demostrable en negociación comercial y cierre de acuerdos con retail.
* Capacidad analítica para trabajar con datos de ventas y construir argumentos comerciales.
* Residencia en **Barcelona o Madrid**.

**Competencias**

* Dominio de técnicas de venta y negociación.
* Gran capacidad para gestionar el tiempo y priorizar; automotivación.
* Capaz de asumir responsabilidad y resolver retos de forma creativa.

**Cómo trabajamos**

Somos un equipo joven, ambicioso y con ganas de hacer las cosas bien. Tenemos base en Barcelona y trabajamos con un modelo remote-first: buscamos a la persona en **Barcelona o Madrid**, con encuentros presenciales con el equipo que acordaremos juntos.

Aquí cada persona es una pieza clave en su función. Si quieres jugar en la liga grande de una marca que está creciendo rápido, ¡queremos conocerte!

title: Cuentas (Barcelona) - Moda & lifestyle y Gran consumo & Lifestyle.
description:
**Queremos conocerte en el equipo de Cuentas Barcelona**

Somos una agencia de comunicación creativa.

Nuestro propósito es conectar a las marcas con sus audiencias de forma genuina, memorable y hecha para durar.

Estamos cerca de la cultura y conectados a las conversaciones que marcan la vida de las personas. Entendemos qué le importa a cada audiencia, y quién la inspira, para ayudar a las marcas a crear contenido relevante y a ganarse un lugar con sentido en la mente de la gente.

Nuestra fórmula: experiencia, curiosidad y trabajo en equipo.

**¿Que buscamos?**

Queremos conocer a profesionales de **dirección de cuentas** que quieran formar parte de nuestro equipo en Barcelona. Abrimos 2 posiciones para liderar la comunicación de marcas de **Moda y Gran consumo. (Moda & lifestyle y Gran consumo & Lifestyle)**

**Cómo es un rol de cuentas en Equipo Singular**

En Equipo Singular, el director/a de cuentas es quién conoce a la marca, el entrono y las tendencias. Quien define la estrategia de comunicación y lidera al equipo para trabajar un buen plan en tiempo y forma, con los mejores resultados para el cliente y la agencia.

**En su día a día:**

* Es el interlocutor principal del cliente y su socio estratégico.
* Define las estrategias de comunicación y relaciones públicas del sus marcas y vela por que cada acción responda a ellas.
* Dirige al equipo multidisciplinar que formamos (prensa, social media, influencers, eventos, contenidos, creatividad, video..) y coordina su trabajo.
* Gestiona la rentabilidad del proyecto: desde el presupuesto y la facturación hasta su cierre de resultados.
* Detecta oportunidades y participa en propuestas a nuevos clientes.
* Tiene un pensamiento crítico para mejorar su día a día, para tomar decisiones, par implementar procesos y herramientas (incluidos la IA) que le ayuden a mejorar a si mismo/a, y al equipo.

**¿Que ofrecemos?**

* **Equipo implicado y con ganas de hacer proyectos retadores,** con una buena dirección general creativa y dirección de negocio.
* **Modelo híbrido:** lunes, martes y jueves en oficina, y miércoles y viernes de teletrabajo voluntario. También se teletrabaja en agosto, Navidad y Semana Santa.
* **Horario:** flexible de entrada y salida, con jornada intensiva todos los viernes y en julio y agosto.
