description:
**About Actian**

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

**This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.**

  

### **What You Will Own:**

1. **Platform Engineering & Architecture**

* Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
* Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
* Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
* Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

2. **Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment**

* Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
* Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
* Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
* Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
* Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

3. **AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations**

* Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.
* Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.
* Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.
* Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
* Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

4. **Security, Compliance & Reliability**

* Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
* Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.
* Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
* Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

5. **Team Building & Leadership**

* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.
* Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.
* Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.
* Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

### **What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:**

* Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.
* Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.
* Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.
* Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.
* Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
* Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.
* Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

### **What You Bring:**

**Leadership & Experience**

* 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
* At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.
* Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
* A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.
* The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
* Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
* Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
* Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
* Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
* Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

**AI-First Mindset**

* Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.
* Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
* Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.
* A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

**Leadership Approach**

* Strong ownership and execution skills.
* Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.
* Able to build teams and systems from scratch.
* Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.
* Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases.
* Production experience across multiple cloud providers.
* Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments.
* Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores.
* OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.
* Privileged access management solutions such as StrongDM.

### **How You Will Work:**

You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support.

This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility.

You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time.

Occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings may be required.

**We value builders over theorists, ownership over hierarchy, and measurable outcomes over activity.**

If you have built and scaled a platform engineering organisation, remain technically hands-on, and believe AI should fundamentally change how infrastructure teams operate, we would like to hear from you.

### **What We Offer:**

* Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.

**Why Join Us?** At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**About UMAEZ**

UMAEZ builds, launches and scales direct-to-consumer brands it owns outright, including GODA. Every revenue function sits in-house, from creative strategy and paid media to retention, creator programs and customer support. We are remote-first and AI-first, with a global team that ships a high volume of performance creative every week.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of our marketing team.

You will connect creative production, retention, creator and affiliate programs, social media initiatives, hiring coordination, external partners and marketing systems, and you will design the workflows and AI integrations that make them run. Your job is to turn priorities into clear assignments, make sure teams have what they need, keep deadlines visible and get approved work to launch.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You will run daily execution while maintaining and improving the systems behind it. In the same week you might clear an urgent production bottleneck, build a ClickUp automation, rebalance an overloaded pod and give leadership a clear read on operational performance.

You will take full ownership of the function through a structured handover with the outgoing Head of Marketing Operations.

**What you'll own**

Daily execution and operating rhythm

* Own the daily operating rhythm of the marketing department. Turn leadership priorities into plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-through.
* Coordinate requests across creative, media buying, retention, customer support, People and external partners. Resolve blockers, manage competing priorities and escalate decisions before they affect delivery.
* Track announcements and feedback from team leads, and turn strategy or priority changes into updated assignments the same day.
* Run the relevant operational meetings, keep action logs and make sure decisions are reflected in team workflows.
* Own the follow-ups and smaller tasks that keep work moving.

Creative production and delivery

* Own the workflow from brief assignment through production, review, revisions, approval, final upload and delivery for launch.
* Work with creative leads and strategists to keep production plans realistic, priorities clear and workloads balanced. Track backlog, overdue tasks, revision queues and upcoming deadlines, and protect the weekly editing cadence so the pipeline is cleared by the end of each week.
* Enforce naming conventions, task requirements, upload procedures and approval gates. Leads and strategists approve their own department's creative; you own the approval flow, including repurposed TikTok edits that admins approve against set guidelines.
* Run pre-launch quality checks on the ads delivery tracker, including content safety (claims, platform policy, visual compliance) and duration and format checks, so every asset is complete, compliant and ready for media buying.
* Oversee the daily delivery sweep with the operations admins. Confirm that approved assets reach media buying, delivery records in ClickUp and Notion stay accurate and launch blockers get timely follow-up.
* Maintain the marketing and launch calendar for campaigns, product launches and seasonal peaks such as BFCM. Coordinate dependencies across creative assets, product information, website readiness and launch teams.
* Brief and prioritize web and design requests, and check output before it goes live.

Pod structure, capacity and team coordination

* Own the operational structure of the creative pods (strategists, video editors and shared resources, including pods run with external creative partners), and adapt it as brands and workloads grow.
* Keep a current view of who supports each strategist, product and brand. Spot staffing gaps, overloaded or idle team members and opportunities to rebalance work.
* Place new joiners in pods, coordinate their access, workflow training and team integration, and keep the pod structure tracker up to date.
* Monitor delivery performance and recurring execution issues. Agree corrective actions with functional leads and follow through until each issue is resolved.

Workflow building and AI integration

* Design and build the operational workflows that connect teams, tools and handoffs, from intake and assignment through review, delivery and reporting.
* Lead AI integration across marketing operations: find where AI can remove manual work or improve quality, then build, test and roll out the solution with the teams who will use it.
* Build and maintain automations, Make scenarios and AI agents (for example Claude skills and MCP connections, ClickUp agents and AI assistants) that handle repetitive coordination: assignment checks, delivery QA, content safety and duration checks, reporting, onboarding messages and sample tracking.
* Test new AI and agentic tools for operations and creative production, and recommend what to adopt, with clear costs, risks and expected time saved.
* Keep a registry of every running automation and agent, with its purpose, owner and schedule. Make sure each one is monitored, documented and that failures surface quickly.
* Train the team to run and trust these workflows, so they keep working without depending on the person who built them.

ClickUp workspace

* Own the marketing ClickUp workspace: structure, lists, statuses, templates, dashboards, permissions, forms and native automations. Serve as the escalation point for ClickUp issues.
* Keep the workspace practical, accurate and usable as team needs change, with consistent processes across internal teams and external partners.
* Make sure tasks hold the information needed for execution, reporting and accountability.

Notion and operational documentation

* Own the architecture and maintenance of the marketing Notion workspace, including operational databases such as the ads delivery and creator sample trackers.
* Keep SOPs, playbooks, team resources and the onboarding knowledge base organized and current, including role-based onboarding templates and walkthrough videos. Every process should have a clear owner and reflect how the team actually works.
* Update documentation whenever workflows change, so essential knowledge is easy to find and does not depend on any one person.

Reporting and operational performance

* Own marketing operations reporting and the accuracy of the trackers behind it.
* Keep visibility into assignments, production, delivery, backlog, capacity, onboarding and operational risks. Turn reporting into clear actions for the team and concise updates for leadership, including a weekly Marketing Operations update and the operations section of the monthly leadership review.
* Define and maintain operational KPIs and their calculations with the relevant stakeholders, such as creative lead time and on-time delivery. Flag missing or inconsistent data before using it to assess performance.
* Identify recurring bottlenecks and implement improvements that speed up execution, reduce avoidable revisions and improve resource use.

AI tools, software and cost oversight

* Own the operational administration of the marketing tool stack (including Higgsfield, HeyGen, Claude, Make, Tagbox and other creative and AI tools): access, onboarding, offboarding, usage tracking and vendor coordination.
* Own monthly Higgsfield credit reporting: credits consumed, allocation by team and project, usage patterns and efficiency metrics such as credits per finished second of video. Forecast requirements and flag overspend early.
* Review software needs with team leads, coordinate renewals and resolve access or usage issues. Cut unnecessary costs and identify tools that make production faster.
* Support the rollout of approved AI workflows, training resources and usage standards.

Retention operations

* Oversee the operating structure that supports the retention team, working closely with the Head of Retention.
* Maintain project and campaign workflows, ownership, timelines, reporting and cross-team dependencies, so the team has the systems and resources to execute consistently.
* Track agreed initiatives, escalate delivery, staffing or coordination issues, and support new retention and growth projects through planning, setup and implementation.

Creator, affiliate and social media programs

* Oversee the creator and affiliate programs, including the Trybe creator program and partner-agency programs: program structure, recruitment and activation workflows, performance tracking and the overall health of each program.
* Maintain onboarding resources, submission processes, approval requirements, tracking and communication procedures. Make sure product samples are tracked from order to delivery and that delayed shipments and missing content are followed up.
* Coordinate issues involving creator permissions, usage rights, asset delivery, attribution and commission setup and internal handoffs.
* Oversee social media initiatives with the social team: content calendars, production and approval workflows, asset delivery and posting cadence. Make sure social plans line up with launches, creator content and paid campaigns.
* Report on program and initiative performance with the relevant leads, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

External partners and vendors

* Manage operational relationships with external creative partners, agencies, vendors and platforms, and lead key partner calls. Keep deliverables, responsibilities, timelines and escalation routes clear.
* Monitor partners and vendors for operational gaps, keep partner documentation current and follow through on open commitments, service issues and agreed improvements.

Creative rewards and commission administration

* Own the administration and documentation of creative rewards programs.
* Maintain eligibility rules, performance trackers, milestone records and calculation procedures. Validate the monthly close with the relevant performance and finance owners before rewards are approved for payment.
* Resolve questions on naming, attribution, iterations and eligibility consistently. Escalate exceptions and proposed rule changes to leadership.

Hiring, onboarding and offboarding coordination

* Partner with the Head of People and functional leads to identify hiring needs based on capacity, workload and performance.
* Keep visibility into open roles, expected start dates, onboardings, exits and resource gaps, and share a regular hiring operations recap.
* Coordinate skills-test logistics for creative candidates with the reviewing leads.
* Prepare new joiners operationally: workspace access, onboarding checklists and ClickUp templates, pod and channel assignments, welcome messages and training resources.
* Oversee the marketing side of offboarding so access is removed across every tool and shared account, and responsibilities and files are handed over properly.
* People owns recruitment and formal HR processes. You own the operational readiness and integration of marketing hires.

Admin team management

* Lead the marketing operations admins. Set weekly priorities, clarify ownership and review the accuracy and completeness of assignment, delivery, reporting and access-management work.
* Keep dependable daily coverage so recurring work continues through absences and staffing changes. Own escalations and fix the process when the same issue comes back.

Leadership support and continuous improvement

* Give the CEO a clear view of operational health, risks, capacity and decisions required.
* Support planning for new products, brands, teams, partners and growth initiatives. Assess operational requirements, resource implications and execution risks before rollout.
* Keep visibility into vendor costs, rewards liabilities and resource allocation, and provide accurate operational inputs for budget and profitability decisions.
* Proactively spot broken or missing processes, and take approved improvements from diagnosis through implementation, documentation and team adoption.

**What success looks like**

* Marketing priorities have clear owners and realistic deadlines. Teams know what to work on, approved assets move steadily toward launch and blockers surface early.
* Every asset that reaches media buying has passed its quality, safety and duration checks, and delivery records match reality.
* Manual coordination keeps shrinking as reliable workflows, automations and AI agents take it over, and the team knows how to run them.
* Creator, affiliate and social media programs run on clear processes, with samples, content, rights and results tracked end to end.
* ClickUp, Notion, automations and trackers stay accurate and useful. Leadership can see production status, capacity and risks without chasing updates.
* New hires join prepared pods with the right access and onboarding, and leavers are offboarded cleanly. External partners follow clear delivery processes.
* Tool usage, Higgsfield credits, costs and rewards are tracked reliably and reconcile to source.
* After the handover, the function runs independently, with you as the central owner of daily coordination, systems and operational improvement.

  
**Requirements**

What we're looking for

* Experience owning marketing operations, creative operations or project operations in a DTC e-commerce business or performance marketing agency.
* Strong hands-on ClickUp skills, including workspace design, dashboards, templates and automations, and confidence building and maintaining Notion documentation.
* A clear understanding of creative production workflows, paid media delivery, retention operations and cross-functional campaign execution.
* Experience coordinating distributed, multi-time-zone teams, managing competing deadlines and holding internal teams and external partners accountable.
* Comfort with spreadsheets, operational reporting, software costs and performance data, and the ability to spot unreliable data and fix the tracking behind it.
* A track record of building workflows and integrating AI into operations (for example Make, Zapier, Claude, ClickUp AI or custom agents), from first idea to a process the team uses every day.
* Experience overseeing creator, affiliate or social media programs, or working closely with the teams that run them.
* Clear written communication, sound judgment and the confidence to make routine operational decisions on your own.

Nice to have

* Experience with AI creative tools such as Higgsfield or HeyGen, and with managing credit-based tool budgets.
* Hands-on experience running creator, UGC or affiliate programs, including sample logistics and commission tracking.
* Experience operating through BFCM or other high-volume launch periods.

Above all, we need someone who takes full ownership, follows through and builds systems the team can rely on.

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive monthly rate based on experience and ability to move fast
* Fully remote — no fixed location, flexible setup
* Access to real performance data and learning from how the creative system actually works at scale
* Exposure to high-volume, multi-market DTC creative production and operations infrastructure

**The role**

We're hiring a Brand Manager to own This Month's Craft end to end, with churn as your main KPI. This Month's Craft is a monthly craft subscription box with two tracks: Creative (relaxing, artistic crafts) and DIY (practical, skill-building crafts).

Your biggest lever on churn is the box: finding, testing, and approving crafts that subscribers love and actually finish. You'll also analyse who we acquire, how the cancellation flow and failed-payment recovery perform, and work closely with customer service and analyze customer feedback. Just as important: you dig into why things happen and check whether each change actually worked. We need your product judgement and your ownership.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Find, test and approve the crafts.** Own the box pipeline for both tracks. Scout craft ideas, order samples, make every kit yourself, and approve or reject it.
* **Own kit quality.** Every kit must be finishable at its stated level: clear instructions, the right tools and materials, nothing missing, packaging that survives shipping. Catch problems before a box ships, not in the reviews.
* **Plan the box calendar.** Balance variety, seasonality and difficulty across Creative and DIY, within the cost-per-box target.
* **Learn from subscribers.** Read and summarize reviews, CS tickets, community posts and cancellation reasons every month, and use them to shape the boxes.
* **Own churn.** It's your main KPI. Understand what drives it by box, channel and track, and act on it.
* **Protect acquisition quality.** Work with performance marketing on channels and first-box offers, and avoid offers that attract one-box buyers.
* **Keep the subscription running smoothly.** Own the cancellation flow (reasons, offers, copy) and failed-payment recovery, with saves that still hold a month later.
* **Stay aligned with Customer Service.** Turn recurring ticket themes into fixes, and close the loop with CS when they ship.

**Skills & experience**
-----------------------

**Must have**

* 1+ years in consumer product development, merchandising or brand management, ideally with craft kits, hobby products or subscription boxes.
* A track record of products you chose or developed, and how customers responded: ratings, sell-through, repeat purchases, returns.
* A hands-on maker. You craft yourself, and you can make a kit and judge its difficulty, instructions and quality.
* Supplier experience: sourcing samples, negotiating, and working to cost targets and lead times.
* Taste grounded in customers. You use reviews and feedback to decide, not only your own preferences.
* Ownership across teams. You push work through with marketing, CS, design, inventory and operations without being chased.
* Comfort with numbers. You can read a retention table and question a figure that looks too good, connect reason with outcome based on numbers
* Clear written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience running a subscription box.
* Experience writing craft instructions.
* An active presence in craft communities or social media.
* Experience with Shopify.
* Spreadsheet analysis skills.

* Foster and cultivate trust within the SRE team, empowering them to implement solid engineering practices and principles.
* Ensure reliability, security and compliance of Seedtag's cloud foundations, aligned with the Google Cloud Architecture Framework and NIST/ISO controls (logging, vulnerability and secrets management, hardening, backup and restore).
* Design, build and operate the internal developer platform (GKE, networking, IAM, CI/CD, GitOps) so product teams can ship autonomously under a "you build it, you run it" model.
* Share knowledge, review peers' work and raise the bar on engineering practices in the team.
* Take part in the Platform on-call rotation, lead incident response and write blameless postmortems, turning recurring issues into automation and lasting fixes.
* Partner with engineering teams to understand their needs and communicate roadmap, trade-offs and progress transparently.
* Operate and evolve our streaming and data infrastructure (Redpanda and self-hosted databases), including migrations, upgrades and the discontinuation of legacy components.
* Own the observability stack (VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, alerting, PagerDuty), tackling scalability problems such as high-cardinality metrics, and define SLIs/SLOs and a service maturity model with engineering teams.
* Drive cost efficiency (FinOps): capacity planning, node and instance right-sizing, quota management and cost anomaly detection.
* Reduce toil and enable self-service: replace tickets with tools, golden paths and reusable CI/CD workflows, and keep documentation and runbooks fresh.
* Apply AI to platform operations: build and operate agents and automations (e.g. cost anomaly detection, PR review, incident triage), define MCP integrations, and contribute to AI governance with Security.

**Outcome over Output**  
We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code.

**Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must**  
Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast.

**We Are All Scouts**  
We take ownership and leave things better than we found them.

**We Are Data-Driven**  
Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results.

* **Languages & Automation:** Python, Go
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:** GCP, Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, Terraform Cloud
* **CI/CD & GitOps:** GitHub Actions, ArgoCD
* **Observability:** VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, PagerDuty
* **Streaming & Data:** Redpanda, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis
* **Security & Networking:** IAM, VPC, Cloudflare, secrets management
* **AI & Automation:** LLM-based agents, MCP integrations

* **Technical Experience:** Minimum of 4 years of experience in SRE/DevOps/Platform/Cloud Engineering roles, preferably in large-scale, high-traffic product companies, with proven technical proficiency and the ability to engage in deep technical conversations with the team.

* **Incident Management and On-call Responsibilities:** Proven on-call and incident management experience, with strong problem-solving skills under pressure and a track record of root-cause analysis and blameless postmortems.
* **Kubernetes:** Solid production experience with Kubernetes, ideally GKE: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, autoscaling and node pool tuning, and workload identity.
* **Infrastructure as Code and GitOps:** Strong Terraform experience (Terraform Cloud a plus), GitOps (ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, self-hosted runners).
* **Observability:** Experience with Prometheus-compatible stacks (VictoriaMetrics, Grafana), alerting design and SLI/SLO practices. Understanding of cardinality and scaling issues is a plus.
* **Security:** Working knowledge of cloud security practices: secrets management, vulnerability and CVE remediation, hardening and least privilege.
* **Other tools and engines:** Streaming platforms (Kafka/Redpanda), or other stateful systems (MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, Aerospike); Cloudflare (CDN, load balancing); compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001); FinOps and capacity planning; hands-on experience building or operating LLM-based agents or automations (e.g. ADK, MCP) and using AI tools in daily engineering work; service maturity / internal developer platform approach.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**The team**
------------

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

**About the role**
------------------

* **What you'll do and for whom.** You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.
* **Where you'll work.** You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.
* **What success looks like.** In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the service that product teams build on.** Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.
* **Own the persistence layer.** Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

* You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

* You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

The Technical Architect will serve as the technical point of reference, with the objective of transforming business goals into robust, evolvable, secure, and operable architectures. * Design scalable and resilient distributed solutions, considering consistency, concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.
* Participate in the development of critical components and conduct code reviews focused on design, maintainability, security, and operational behavior.
* Define the testing and quality strategy: unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, performance, resilience, and security testing.
* Design and review APIs, integration contracts, persistence schemas, and compatibility and evolution mechanisms.
* Evaluate performance and capacity through analysis, profiling, load testing, and the definition of measurable latency and throughput targets.
* Ensure the automation of builds, validations, static analysis, deployments, and quality controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* Integrate secure-by-design principles, threat modeling, secrets management, access control, and traceability into the architecture.
* Identify technical risks, structural debt, and bottlenecks; prioritize their remediation and communicate their impact on timeline, cost, and scope.
* Participate in planning complex deliveries, technical estimations, milestone definition, and tracking architectural commitments.

* More than 4 years of experience as a Technical Architect, with demonstrable experience leading the design and delivery of platforms or projects of high technical complexity.
* At least 5 years of experience in software development and in Java, Spring Boot, APIs, persistence, distributed systems, automated testing, and CI/CD.
* Experience in regulated or financial environments with high availability, performance, security, and traceability requirements.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, defining standards, managing technical debt, and evolving existing systems.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies and collaborating cross-functionally with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Business teams.
* Advanced experience with Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x, and designing mission-critical enterprise applications.
* Mastery of microservices architecture, distributed systems, synchronous and asynchronous integration, and communication patterns.
* In-depth knowledge of REST API design, contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, and integration governance.
* Experience with Spring Data JPA, data modeling, transactions, PostgreSQL, and query and persistence optimization.
* Experience with Gradle or Maven, multi-module projects or composite builds, dependency management, and build automation.
* Mastery of SOLID principles, DDD, Clean Architecture, design patterns, and refactoring and safe evolution techniques.
* Experience defining testing strategies using JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, as well as contract, integration, and performance testing.
* Solid knowledge of concurrency, caching, messaging, idempotency, consistency, resilience, and fault tolerance.
* Experience with Git, code reviews, branching strategies, and collaborative development practices at scale.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated quality, static analysis, artifact management, and controlled deployments.
* Knowledge of observability: structured logs, metrics, distributed traces, alerting, and production diagnostics.

Languages

* **Minimum B2 English level, mandatory.** A professional level is required to lead decisions and collaborate with international teams.
* **Spanish – professional level, minimum B2, mandatory.**

Nice to Have

* Experience in the architecture of financial platforms, corporate banking, trading, or high-criticality transactional systems.
* Experience with event-driven architectures, Kafka, or other messaging and distributed processing platforms.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud, and deployment patterns such as blue-green, canary, and rolling releases.
* Experience applying OAuth2, OpenID Connect, threat modeling, secrets management, and application security controls.
* Knowledge of SRE, SLO/SLI, capacity, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Experience in application modernization, progressive migrations, the strangler pattern, and technical debt reduction.
* Experience defining architecture standards, technical reviews, and governance models in large organizations.
* Domain knowledge of Trade Finance or Documentary Trade.

**What do we offer you?**

* Full-time or B2B contract
* **Remote within CET Time zone.**
* Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

**If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you !**

title: Senior Manager Pricing
description:
Overview:

**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**ABOUT THE ROLE AND THE TEAM**

You will lead pricing for the **Airports & Borders Business Unit**, aiming to grow revenue, protect margin and price consistently across all GEOs. You will be the BU's main pricing partner: you'll shape investment cases, support deal teams in building accurate, well-governed quotes, and make the CPQ-based pricing operating model the standard way of working across the company. You will also manage a team of pricing professionals.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Pricing strategy and governance**

* Set and maintain the BU's pricing strategy: segmentation, floor and ceiling prices, discounting rules and pricing authority levels.
* Make sure the BU's price books and quoting tools are accurate and up to date, and own the communication of price book changes, pricing guidelines and bid strategy to GEOs and Sales.
* Enforce discount and pricing guardrails.

**Deal support and approval**

* Work with Sales, Solution Design, Commercial Management to build quotes that are accurate, competitive and within pricing guidelines.
* Advise deal teams on pricing structure, discount levels and commercial options for large and non-standard opportunities.
* Prepare and challenge price, cost and margin analyses and business cases for the CBAB/BAB approval process.
* Create dashboards and tracking models on how far deal prices move from standard price and report the BU's pricing KPIs to management every month.

**Business Unit partnership and investment cases**

* Be the trusted pricing counterpart to Airports & Borders BU leadership.
* Build and defend business cases for the BU Investment Boards.
* Price new and non-catalogue offers and turn them into structured, repeatable price models.

**CPQ operating model: adoption, change management and continuous improvement**

* Own Pricing's part of the CPQ (LogiQuote) operating model: governance, prioritising the backlog, design decisions and Go/No-Go for releases.
* Organize sessions to support and train Solution Design and Commercial Management on CPQ
* Lead change management so that every GEO, Sales, Solution Design and the support functions adopt the new model, with CPQ as the single quoting route.
* Bring new teams, products and business lines (for example Borders) into CPQ, with training, guidance and support for users.
* Improve the model continuously: track adoption and quote quality, find and fix workarounds (such as quotes built in Excel outside CPQ), and extend CPQ to handle complex deal structures.
* Keep data consistent across Salesforce, CPQ and billing, for example quote and opportunity value alignment and item master controls. Work with Billing to improve how orders flow through to invoices.

**Supplier and cost**

* Work with Procurement to keep the cost book accurate and update it regularly with current third-party supplier costs and transfer prices.
* Keep internal software costs current so that pricing models and quotes reflect the true cost base.

**People leadership**

* Lead a team of about 4 pricing professionals: set objectives, manage performance and develop each person.
* Share pricing and CPQ expertise across the team and with GEO stakeholders.

Qualifications:

**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS:**

* 8+ years in pricing, business finance or product management, including 2+ years managing people.
* Mastery of pricing principles and a strong commercial background.
* Proven record of designing pricing strategies that improved margin.
* Strong financial modelling (Excel, business cases, NPV and margin analysis) and data analytics.

title: CS Team Lead
description:
**Who we are**
==============

With a global **mission** to help people live longer, healthier lives, **Docplanner** Group is the world's biggest healthcare platform. We serve patients and healthcare professionals across 13 countries in Europe and LATAM, with a network of more than 2.8 million healthcare professionals and over 20 million bookings every month. Our global team of around 3,000 people works from offices in Warsaw, Istanbul, Rome, Barcelona, Mexico City, Bogotá, Curitiba, Rio, Munich and Berlin.

**About the role**
------------------

Clinic Agenda is growing, and so is the number of clinics that rely on it every day. We are looking for a Team Lead to turn a Customer Success team of around 8 reps into the reason clinics stay and grow with us.

Our Customer Success processes are mature and well established. We expect you to master them quickly and then challenge them: give you feedback on what you think it works, sharpen what doesn't, and move the team from reacting to churn requests to a proactive, commercial and data-driven approach. You will be measured on results, and you will have the autonomy to decide how to get them.

**How you work**
----------------

* **Numbers first.** You open every discussion with data. You know your portfolio's health, churn and expansion figures without having to look them up.
* **Data-driven decisions.** Intuition gives you a hypothesis; data confirms or rejects it. You test, measure and adjust.
* **You escalate always with** **a proposal.** When something needs leadership's attention, you bring the analysis, the options and your recommendation.
* **Ownership and accountability.** You take full ownership of your team's results. When a target is at risk, you are the first to see it, explain it and present the plan to recover it.
* **Outcomes over activity.** You care about results, not about how busy the team looks.
* **You build people.** You set clear expectations, give honest feedback and measure your own success by how much your reps improve. You also take tough decisions if needed.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Build a high-performing team**

* Lead, coach and develop around 8 Customer Success Reps, some of them early in their careers.
* Set clear expectations, run regular 1:1s and call reviews, and give direct, actionable feedback.
* Spot skill gaps early, build training plans to close them and track each rep's performance continuously.
* Hire, onboard and grow talent so the team gets stronger.

**Grow the portfolio**

* Co-own with RevOps and CS Manager, the upselling and cross-selling strategy across the existing clinic base.
* Use product usage and customer data to find expansion opportunities and turn them into revenue.

**Protect the base**

* Run retention and churn-reduction strategies across the portfolio.
* Detect at-risk clinics early through usage, engagement, support signals, and act before they churn.

**Raise the standard**

* Master our established Customer Success processes and KPIs, then challenge them with data and improve what no longer works.
* Keep workflows, escalation paths and service-level standards up to date and consistently applied.
* Structure internal documentation so reps can find the information they need, fast.
* Design an onboarding programme for new joiners that shortens their ramp-up time.
* Analyse quality insights with our internal AI tool to improve process adherence and service quality.
* Ensure smooth day-to-day operations: capacity, coverage and service levels are always under control.

**Work across teams**

* Coordinate with Sales, Product, Finance and Customer Care so clinics get one seamless experience.
* Partner with Revenue Operations on reporting, automation and prioritization.
* Step into key customer conversations when the situation needs it.

**What you'll own**

* **Expansion MRR:** New recurring revenue from upselling and cross-selling to existing clinics
* **Churn MRR:** Recurring revenue lost through cancellations and downgrades
* **Net Revenue Retention:** Overall revenue kept and grown across the portfolio
* **Onboarding & Farming Quality:** Overall quality standards

Salary in line with your experience.  
Most importantly: an amazing team that will support you every step of the way.  
Private health insurance.  
Your birthday off to spend with your loved ones.  
Free language classes.

Hybrid working, with a minimum of 1 day a week at our Barcelona offices.

Strategic conversation: an interview with gustavo and Patri  
c-level interview: With Cyril our Head of CS.

title: Product Manager
description:
### **About our Crew**

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy. We spend each day surrounded by 500,000 boats from across the globe!

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

To support this growth, we're hiring a **Product Manager, Monetization & Compliance** to join our Product team in Barcelona.

### **The role**

We're looking for a Product Manager with a strong business mindset to own our **monetization and compliance roadmap**. You will identify and ship the right opportunities to grow our **revenue and contribution margin**, while keeping the product compliant on **tax and invoicing**.

You'll own the strategy and the priorities, while delivery is run by your squad and its Engineering Manager. You'll work closely with **finance, data, legal and operations**, with regular exposure to our leadership team, and play a central role in meeting our revenue and margin targets.

**The Product team at Click&Boat: 4 Product Managers**, 1 Head of Product, 1 VP product organized into squads, each dedicated to a specific functional scope. Together, they deliver a first-class experience to our users: boat owners, renters, and Click&Boat's internal teams.

### **What floats your boat**

* **Build a point of view:** you develop strong convictions on where we can grow revenue, and where Click&Boat should place its bets (pricing, fees, payments, upsells, checkout).
* **Vision & Roadmap:** you align the leadership team around a clear product vision, then turn it into a 3 to 6 month roadmap and concrete priorities that help your squad deliver maximum value against our OKRs.
* **Compliance by design:** you make sure tax, invoicing and regulatory requirements are built into the product, partnering with finance and legal to turn constraints into clean, scalable solutions.
* **Data-driven decisions:** you analyze quantitative and qualitative data to size opportunities, measure revenue impact and learn from every release.
* **Decision making:** you're comfortable deciding with 40 to 70% of the information, using data to guide you without waiting for perfect certainty.
* **Fail fast, learn fast:** you promote rapid iterations, A/B tests and continuous improvement, always with a "user first" approach.

### **What you bring aboard**

* Significant experience as a Product Manager, regardless of the scope.
* You are both strategic and hands-on: able to define a monetization strategy and a long-term roadmap, while still going deep into a checkout experiment or a revenue metric when needed.
* A strong business and data mindset, with decisions grounded in solid analysis.
* Structure and excellent prioritization: you manage your time and stakeholders effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication: you justify your decisions with clarity and confidence, from squads to top management.
* You embrace feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
* Fluent or bilingual in English.

**Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)**

* Experience in a marketplace, tech or B2C company.
* Experience in pricing, payments, or regulated features (tax, invoicing), with a measurable revenue impact.
* Fluency in French and/or Spanish.

### **The hiring journey**

* HR call with Talent Acquisition,
* Interview with the Product team,
* Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values: leadership, strategic thinking, learn & grow.
* Final Interview with Nicolas, our CTPO

We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

### **️** **What awaits you on board**

* A high-impact scope, directly tied to Click&Boat's revenue and margin, with direct exposure to top management;
* Personal and professional development in a fast-growing, multicultural team;
* 8 additional days off;
* Lunch vouchers (Cobee);
* Gym partnerships (Wellhub);
* PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;
* Breakfast every Tuesday morning;
* A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20-minute walk from the sea;
* Team-building activities;
* Hybrid role based in Barcelona (3 days per week at the office), with 3 days per month spent in Paris, around 6 to 9 trips per year.

**Contract:** Permanent position

**Start date:** ASAP

### **Ready to join?**

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.

Remember, even if you don't meet every requirement, you might still be a great match for us! And yes, we're especially talking to women here: science says that you are less likely to apply if you don't meet them all. So go for it, we'd love to hear from you.

At Click&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We hire for talent, drive, and mindset. The sea is open to all.

title: Senior Business Innovation Consultant
description:

We are a global boutique, strategic design and innovation consultancy. We help our clients create products, services, and experiences that delight customers and that fuel growth. By blending strategy, creativity, technology and business insight to design and deliver the most meaningful solutions.

This role is for you if

**Commercial & Marketing Support (~20%):** Support in proposal preparation, organic account opportunity identification, content creation, and methodology enhancements.

**Financial Modeling & Business Craft –** Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and interpret complex financial models from scratch to support unit economics, revenue forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.

**Collaboration & Workshop Platforms:** High proficiency in collaboration platforms such as Miro.

**Generative AI Platforms:** LLMs and agentic workflow tools applied to market scanning, trend analysis, and research synthesis under strict confidentiality rules.

**Qualifications**

Willingness to travel for client meetings, field research, and workshops.

Valid work permit for Spain/Europe.

A valid driving license (minimum 2 years of seniority) is appreciated.

title: Global Social Media Specialist
description:
### **Position**

The Global Social Media Specialist reports directly to the Head of Global Media and Social Media, collaborating closer with other functions and departments including global and local Marketing teams.

This role acts as a key point of contact for regional Marketing teams, ensuring alignment between global social media strategy, content creation, planning and local marketing execution.

**Your Mission:**

To manage and execute LOEWE Perfumes’ global organic social media presence, ensuring a consistent, distinctive and engaging brand expression across international markets and platforms.

The role combines global social media management, editorial calendar ownership, creative content ideation, trend analysis and global coordination.

The Global Social Media Specialist will play a key role in identifying social media trends, defining content opportunities and translating platform insights into clear, actionable creative briefs for the Creative and Content teams.

The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of social media culture with a refined aesthetic sensibility, ensuring that LOEWE Perfumes’ unique creative universe is translated into relevant, innovative and platform-specific storytelling while preserving the brand’s luxury positioning.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Global Social Media Management & Editorial Planning**

* Manage day-to-day execution of LOEWE Perfumes’ global organic social channels, ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, tone of voice and content quality.
* Own the global editorial calendar, aligning brand priorities, launches, campaigns, cultural moments and key marketing initiatives.
* Oversee end-to-end content planning: identify needs, define Creative briefs, coordinate asset delivery with internal stakeholders, schedule, publish and track performance.
* Translate global campaign storytelling into platform-specific content to maximize relevance and engagement.
* Evolve the brand’s organic presence through new formats, creative approaches, and platform developments.
* Monitor audience conversations, emerging trends and community sentiment, identifying opportunities for meaningful engagement and stronger brand affinity.
* Gather community insights to inform content planning and creative recommendations.

**Creative Content Ideation**

* Identify emerging trends, cultural conversations, formats, and content opportunities relevant to LOEWE Perfumes.
* Develop original, innovative, social-first ideas that translate the brand universe into engaging, platform-specific storytelling, including content beyond global campaign assets.
* Define creative and actionable briefs for Creative and Content teams, covering objectives, key messages, storytelling, formats and platform requirements.
* Partner with these teams throughout development to optimize creative execution for each platform.
* Contribute a social media perspective to brainstorming, campaign planning and content reviews; continuously evolve the content approach through creativity, cultural awareness and performance insights.

**Global & Regional Social Media Coordination**

* Act as a key contact between HQ and regional teams, aligning organic social media planning, content and define guidelines.
* Coordinate global calendars and content deployment across markets, including Asian channels (WeChat, RED, Weibo, Douyin, LINE, KakaoTalk)
* Support reviews of regional calendars, creative proposals and local adaptations, ensuring alignment with global strategy and approval processes.
* Facilitate HQ–regional communication and content sharing for efficient workflows and timely execution.
* Monitor international social media developments, particularly in Asia, to identify trends, best practices and brand opportunities.
* Contribute to global social media guidelines and content frameworks.

**Social Media Performance & Optimization**

* Analyze organic performance across global platforms, including reach, engagement, audience growth, video views and content effectiveness.
* Produce regular reports with actionable insights to improve content and channel performance.
* Benchmark competitors and track developments across luxury, beauty and digital culture, translating findings and performance insights into creative recommendations and content opportunities.
* Partner with Paid Media to identify organic content amplification opportunities and align paid and organic initiatives.
* Support testing of new formats, creative approaches, and platform features.

### **Profile**

**Hard Skills**

* Proven experience managing organic social media channels for international or global brands, including content planning, editorial calendar management and publishing.
* Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Instagram and TikTok, including platform-specific content formats, best practices and audience behavior.
* Previous experience or demonstrated working knowledge of Asian social media platforms, particularly WeChat, Xiaohongshu (RED), Weibo, Douyin, LINE and/or KakaoTalk.
* Experience coordinating content calendars, campaigns and social media activities across multiple markets or regional teams.
* Strong ability to identify social media trends and translate them into relevant content concepts, creative directions and actionable briefs.
* Proven experience collaborating with Creative and Content teams on content ideation, briefing, development and execution.
* Strong understanding of social-first storytelling, short-form video formats and platform-specific creative best practices.
* Ability to assess creative content from both a brand positioning and social media performance perspective.
* Experience with social media management, scheduling, listening and analytics tools.
* Strong understanding of organic social media KPIs and performance reporting.
* Awareness of digital culture, emerging social media trends and luxury industry best practices.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong creative instinct and refined aesthetic sensibility, with a deep understanding of luxury brand codes.
* Ability to translate social media insights into relevant creative opportunities.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple content streams, deadlines and stakeholders.
* Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of projects.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, particularly in multicultural and international environments.
* Ability to balance creative thinking with operational excellence and attention to detail.
* Curious, culturally aware and passionate about social media, luxury, beauty and digital storytelling.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Approachable, inclusive and collaborative.

**Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communication, Digital Media or similar
* 2–4 years of experience in social media, digital marketing
* Demonstrated experience managing editorial calendars and coordinating social media content across multiple markets.
* Previous experience developing content concepts and creative briefs in collaboration with Creative and Content teams.
* Experience or strong familiarity with Asian social media ecosystems, with an understanding of how content strategies and platform dynamics differ from Western markets.
* Experience in luxury, fragrance, fashion or lifestyle brands is highly valued.
* Proven examples of social media projects demonstrating editorial planning, creative ideation and collaboration with creative teams.
* Fluent English, written and spoken. Spanish is highly valuable; additional languages, particularly Asian languages, are a plus.

### **Additional information**

*LOEWE Perfumes represents the organic part of LOEWE. We are the unique Maison that crafts* *collectable botanical art pieces* *connected with nature in its purest form.*

*LOEWE Perfumes respects diversity and promotes inclusion from its recruitment process. We are committed to create an integrative working environment where all talents and singularities are engaged and valued.*

***LOEWE PERFUMES*** 
**MAISON**
--------------------------------

LOEWE Perfumes adds a multisensory dimension to LOEWE via a kaleidoscopic range of iconic fragrances for men, for women and for the home that combine vibrant, nature-inspired olfactory experiences with bold visual expression.
  
In 1972, LOEWE launched its first women’s fragrance: L de Loewe. Because of its success, the House began investing in international perfumery retail. LOEWE Perfumes has kept sustaining the brand’s Spanish legacy, artisanal savoir-faire and innovative spirit guided, since 2013, by the creative vision of Jonathan Anderson, LOEWE’s Creative Director, in partnership with in-house perfumier, Nuria Cruelles.

title: Senior Environment Surfacing Artist
description:
Skydance offers a dynamic, inclusive, and ever-evolving culture where innovative ideas are welcomed, and growth fostered. The partnership between unique creativity and technological advancements are demonstrated within each pillar of the company. At the heart of it all is a commitment to boldly entertaining and relevant storytelling.

While all Animation studios look to hire people who are creative and hard-working, Skydance Animation is specifically looking for pioneers who seek to push the limits of what the world’s most collaborative art form can achieve, and to give those pioneers the space and the resources to build a new studio that’s doing something different.

For more information on how we process your personal information, please review the Privacy policy located at https://privacy.paramount.com/recruitment-privacy-notice.

-

As an Environment Senior Surfacing Artist, you will collaborate with the Production team, Production Designer, Art Director, and Environment Supervisor to develop the visual language and surface aesthetics of environments and props throughout the film. You will create and refine materials, textures, and surfacing solutions across a wide range of artistic styles while maintaining the creative vision of the project. You will work within modern production workflows using tools and technologies such as USD, Substance Painter/Designer, Houdini, RenderMan, and RizomUV.

### **Responsibilities**

* Creates and develops stylized and realistic textures using photographic references, hand-painted techniques, procedural workflows, and existing texture assets, adapting approaches to different artistic styles and production requirements.
* Researches visual references and develops surfacing solutions independently when concept art or direct visual guidance is unavailable.
* Translates the Production Designer’s vision into cohesive surfacing solutions that support the overall visual language of the film.
* Ensures surfacing quality, consistency, and adherence to the established visual direction across assets, environments, and sequences.
* Creates, refines, and maintains materials using standard and procedural shading workflows, balancing artistic requirements with appropriate physical properties and visual style.
* Troubleshoots technical issues, tracks progress, and follows through to resolution.
* Takes ownership of assigned assets, ensuring quality and timely delivery.
* Collaborates with Supervisors, Leads, and upstream/downstream departments, including Modeling, Set Dressing, Rigging, Lighting, FX, and Compositing.
* Shares knowledge and supports the growth of less experienced artists.
* Proposes solutions to artistic and technical challenges, defining the best ways to proceed.
* Demonstrates strong organizational skills, including task prioritization and effective time management across multiple assignments.
* Maintains clear, proactive, and transparent communication.

### **Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in the VFX or animation industry.
* 3+ years in the animation industry is desirable.
* Strong artistic sensibility and/or technical expertise related to 3D animation and VFX are required.
* Experience in Renderman and/or Arnold.
* Experience with Substance 3D Painter, Substance 3D Designer, and/or Mari.
* Strong knowledge of UV creation and layout.
* Understanding of related departments' workflows, including Modeling, Set Dressing, Lighting, FX, and Compositing.
* Experience optimizing complex scenes and rendering workflows.
* Experience managing large scenes, complex environments, and demanding sequences.
* Knowledge of Houdini, Solaris or Katana is desirable.
* USD and/or OSL knowledge is a plus.
* Knowledge of vegetation workflows (instances and scatters) is a plus.
* Understanding of displacement workflows (maps and geometry output).
* High English level desirable.

#Animation #LI-Hybrid

Skydance is a diversified media company founded by David Ellison in 2010 to create high quality, event-level entertainment for global audiences. The Company brings to life stories of immersive worlds across its feature film, television, interactive, and animation divisions.

title: ​​Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Officer (Identity and Access Management) ​(P)
description:
**Introduction**

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Internal and external candidates will be considered for this vacancy.

For the purposes of this vacancy, internal candidates are defined as staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded or ungraded contract, including Junior Professional Officers (JPOs), UN Volunteers with at least twelve (12) months of continuous service in IOM, staff on Special Leave Without Pay (SLWOP), and staff members on secondment/loan released by the Organization, unless otherwise specified in their contract. Staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded contract will not retain their contract type if appointed to an ungraded position.

**Organizational Context and Scope**

The ICT Officer Identity and Access Management will lead own and evolve the identity and access management (IDAM) ecosystem. The role will be the gatekeeper for the digital identity landscape, ensuring the right people (and devices) get the right access, at the right time, for the right reasons.

The role will be responsible for the design, implementation, and support of the identity orchestration using One Identity - Identity Manager (IDM), integrated with Microsoft Active Directory, Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID), and HR-driven lifecycle events via the Oracle ERP (WAVE).

The ICT Officer (Identity and Access Management) must understand the art and science of automating access, enforcing least privilege, and reducing identity-related risks.
  
Under the leadership of the Director of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) / Chief Information Officer and reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, the ICT Officer Identity and Access Management (IDAM) is responsible for the identity and access management function within ICT.

  

Responsibilities: IDENTITY AND ACCESS MANAGEMENT  
  
Design, configure, and maintain One Identity - Identity Manager (IDM) for user lifecycle management, provisioning, and role-based access control.  
Integrate identity data from the WAVE ERP system to drive Joiner/Mover/Leaver (JML) processes.  
Manage synchronization and identity federation between Microsoft Active Directory and Azure Active Directory (Entra ID).  
Define and implement access governance, including role modelling, segregation of duties (SoD), and access review campaigns.  
Develop automated workflows for account provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement management across all ICT platforms.  
Collaborate with HR, Information Security, and Compliance teams to enforce identity related policies.  
Enforce Just-In-Time (JIT) access for sensitive operations.  
Monitor and respond to identity-related incidents and service requests.  
Create and maintain IAM documentation including architecture diagrams, SOPs, and audit records.  
Supervise the IAM team and conduct effective performance management and promote a cooperative work environment.  
  
MICROSOFT ACTIVE DIRECTORY AND ENTRA ID  
  
Ensure correct operation of hybrid identity sync from AD to Entra ID via Azure AD Connect and monitor sync health and conflict resolution.  
Define entitlement management with access packages for joiners/movers/leavers.  
Enforce naming conventions and OU placement standards.  
Manage service accounts with lifecycle governance (preferably with expiration controls).  
Manage access using Azure AD roles, administrative units, and custom roles.  
Assign privileged roles via Privileged Identity Management (PIM) with time-bound or approval-based access.  
Define Conditional Access Policies based on risk, device, location, and user sensitivity.  
Enforce MFA using built-in Entra policies.  
Enable the publishing and management of SaaS apps using SAML, OAuth, or OIDC for Single Sign-On (SSO).  
Configure provisioning connectors to automate account creation in cloud apps.  
Build processes to enforce user consent restrictions to limit data exposure to risky apps.  
Create and maintain procedures for maintenance of security groups and distribution lists.  
Implement and enforce role-based access control (RBAC) through group nesting and inheritance.  
Periodically review and clean up stale groups and memberships and establish access review campaigns for groups, apps, and privileged roles across regional offices.  
  
ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES  
  
Provide input for the license entitlements and ensure correct integration with FinOps and licensing portals.  
* Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

  

Qualifications: Education  
  
Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or,  
University degree in the above fields with seven years of relevant professional experience.  
The following certifications are required.  
Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300).  
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).  
Must attain and maintain ITIL version 4 Foundation certification and CISSP.  
One Identity - Identity Manager Foundations (#IM-FND) certification is an advantage.  
Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) is an added advantage.  
  
Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database .  
  
Experience  
  
A minimum of 5 years of experience in Identity & Access Management, IT Security, or related infrastructure engineering roles.  
Hands-on experience with One Identity - Identity Manager (strongly preferred).  
Solid proficiency in Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy, and Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID).  
Experience in integrating IAM solutions with ERP systems for automated provisioning (e.g. SAP, Oracle).  
Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect).  
Experience implementing RBAC, ABAC, and SoD controls.  
Strong scripting ability (PowerShell, SQL, or similar) for automating IAM workflows.  
  
Skills  
  
Demonstrated ability to supervise and train teams to work effectively and harmoniously.  
Project management skills for efficient roll-out of ICT initiatives.  
Demonstrated understanding of automation of user lifecycle processes across HR, AD, and Entra ID.  
Demonstrated ability to communicate with business leaders and those with limited technical background effectively.  
Demonstrated ability to handle confidential data in a professional, responsible and mature manner.  
Familiarity with global IT security trends and the ability to adapt NIST standards to evolving security threats and technologies.  
Working knowledge of supporting One Identity Manager, Active Directory and Entra ID.  
  
Languages  
  
For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written).  
  
Working knowledge of an official UN Language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, and Spanish) is an advantage.  
  
Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.  
  
Required Competencies  
  
IOM's competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.  
  
Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:  
  
Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.  
Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.  
Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.

Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.  
Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.

Notes  
  
Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.  
  
Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security as well as accreditation, any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted.

IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children.  
  
IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times.  
  
IOM does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for application, interview, processing, training, or otherwise—and does not request any information related to bank accounts.  
  
IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM WAVE system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
