* Be the operational voice in the rollout of our new case management platform, making sure workflows reflect how cases are really handled
* Bring coaching back to the floor - buddy systems and hands-on onboarding - so new advisors and partner staff get up to speed fast and continuously improve
* Lead the move to a model where complex cases are solved end to end by our in-house experts, with no escalation layers

**Build bridges**

* Work as one team with our enablement functions: be clear about what the front line needs, and hold them to it
* Represent the voice of our guests and hosts in cross-functional discussions with Product, Tech, Sales and Account Management

**What success looks like**

* 30 days: you know every Team Lead, have handled cases in each queue, and have spent time with our partners
* 90 days: shared targets are agreed with Team Leads and partners, a weekly performance rhythm is running, and first quick wins are delivered
* 6 months: measurable improvement in cost per resolved case, CSAT, escalation rates, a stronger Team Lead bench, and all advisors performing to a higher standard

**What you bring**

* 8+ years of experience in customer service or customer operations, of which 4+ managing managers or multiple teams
* Has led an operation of 100+ people across in-house and outsourced teams
* A proven track record of turning around team performance, with measurable gains in both productivity and quality
* Experience managing outsourced support partners (BPOs) on performance and quality
* A leader who sets a high bar and holds people to it, while genuinely caring about their growth - you help your teams meet expectations rather than shield them from them
* Hands-on: you're comfortable stepping onto the floor and handling cases yourself
* Strong with data - you use KPIs to find root causes and drive action, not just to report
* Experience leading teams through change - new tools, new structures - while keeping people engaged
* Experience with complex, emotional B2C cases (eg. travel, hospitality, tour operators), not only transactional ticket queues
* AI-literate: you use AI tools in your own work, and you have run a team alongside AI agents or automation. You know where AI resolves, where it fails, and how to measure it.
* Fluent English; another of our market languages (Spanish, German, Italian, French) is a plus

  

**What we offer**

* **Impact:** Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters—and you’ll see the impact.
* **Learning:** Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets—with a strong focus on AI.
* **Great People:** Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts—people we can all relate to—making work meaningful and energizing.
* **Technology:** Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.
* **Flexibility:** Work in a hybrid setup with 50%+ in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.
* **Perks on Top:** Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized—but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.

**Fitch Ratings is currently seeking a Senior Analyst or Associate Director, Fis – Spanish Banks based out of our Madrid office.**

  

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

  

At Fitch Ratings, credit analysts play a pivotal role in moving markets, as quality credit analysis is the lifeblood of our organization. With a legacy of over a century, our unique approach to credit ratings offers unmatched opportunities for professional growth. Embracing a “challenger mindset,” you'll join a team dedicated to innovating service to our clients. Our people-driven analysis thrives on collaboration across all levels and locations, surpassing traditional financial modeling. Lastly, as part of our global community, you'll find inspiration, challenge, and support, with ample opportunities for visibility and influence in the global financial marketplace.

  

Want to learn more about a career as a credit analyst at Fitch Ratings? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Credit-Analysts/

  

**About the Team**

  

The Fitch Ratings Financial Institutions Group has actively built the agency into the global leader in bank credit rating coverage. Our experienced analysts provide comprehensive, timely and transparent coverage of major institutions around the world, as well as unparalleled coverage of smaller companies. Our analysts offer a diversity of talent and backgrounds, with experience in regulatory oversight, counterparty analysis, auditing, investment banking, buy-side investing and more.

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Monitoring a portfolio of issuer ratings, including the preparation of rating committee materials

* Participation in credit rating committees for banks in the allocated region and other countries
* Regular interaction with contacts at issuers and with issuers’ senior management at rating meetings
* Participation in the publication of sector-specific research and commentary, including preparation of peer data, country snapshots and sector background information
* Assist as needed in the coverage of other banks in the portfolio; including working with other team members to prepare committee materials, peer tables or analytical tools, reviewing annual and interim accounts and completing ad-hoc data requests

  

**You May be a Good Fit if:**

* Proven analytical experience (ideally between 4 and 6 years), ideally in credit- or audit-related fields, gained from working at a commercial/investment bank, accountancy firm, buy-side firm, regulatory authority, rating agency, or similar.
* Background in either financial institutions or corporate credit analysis. Experience in bank analysis and banking regulation is desirable.
* Excellent demonstrable written and verbal communication skills in Spanish (native level) and English are essential.
* Ability to work independently as well as being a good team player.
* Ability to cope with time pressure and work to deadlines.
* Strong writing and communication skills as well as strong command of financial statement analysis.
* Proficient in Excel
* A drive for innovation and appetite to find smart ways to implement AI into daily analytical tasks.

This position will involve occasional travel, primarily within Europe.

  

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* Knowledge of another European language such as Portuguese is desired but not essential.
* University degree level, preferably with professional qualifications (such as CFA).

  

**Why Choose Fitch:**

* **Hybrid Work Environment:** 3 days a week in office required
* **A Culture of Learning & Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* **Promoting Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Inclusive Work Environment**: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

  

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.

  

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

As GTM Engineer, you will build the systems that allow a small commercial team to operate at the scale of a much larger one. Reporting directly to the Director of Clients, New Business and Institutional Relations, you will design and run the data, automation and AI workflows behind Mormedi's client relationships, campaigns and proposals.

**This role is for you if**  
You move easily between business and technology. You have built or automated something on your own initiative, you get bored doing the same task twice, and you want to see your tools used every day by the people around you.

**What you will own**

* **AI agents and workflows:** building agents and automations for account research, data enrichment, meeting briefings and first drafts.
* **Commercial stack:** connecting and maintaining our CRM, Apollo, LinkedIn, email and event tools into one coherent system.
* **Campaign infrastructure:** setting up the lists, sequences, personalisation and tracking behind growth campaigns.
* **Proposal support tools:** automating the repetitive parts of proposal work, such as tender monitoring, content retrieval and compliance checklists.
* **Data and dashboards:** building the pipeline dashboard the team uses every week to decide where to focus.
* **Tool scouting:** testing new tools and keeping only those that genuinely add value.
* **Responsible AI and data protection:** ensuring every workflow respects GDPR, the EU AI Act, client confidentiality and Mormedi's internal policies.
* **Quality and Environmental standards (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001):** documenting processes and supporting continuous efficiency within the team.

**How success is measured**

* **Systems in use (~70%):** workflows in daily use, hours saved and data quality in the CRM.
* **Impact on results (~30%):** contribution of automation to campaign performance and proposal speed.

**What you bring**

* **Builder mindset:** You have automated something or built a tool on your own. No need to be a software engineer.
* **Technical fluency:** Comfort with APIs, integrations, spreadsheets and data structures.
* **Business sense:** Ability to understand how a commercial team works and where time is lost.
* **Ownership:** You spot what should be built, propose it and prove it works.
* **AI literacy:** Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic workflows, with care for data privacy and confidentiality.

title: Public Relations & Marketing Assistant Manager - Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor
description:
Job ID: REQ10397675

Four Seasons Mallorca at Formentor

Location: Illes Balears, Illes Balears, Spain

widget: Full time

  

**About Four Seasons:**

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.
  
  
At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

**About the location:**

Welcome to Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor. Perched on the spectacular Formentor Peninsula, surrounded by the Mediterranean Sea and the breathtaking landscapes of Mallorca, Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor is a truly extraordinary place to work. Originally opened in 1929, this iconic retreat has been reimagined following an extensive restoration, reopening in August 2024 as Four Seasons’ first resort in Mallorca. Set within a vast private estate, the Resort combines its rich heritage and poetic charm with contemporary luxury and the warm, authentic spirit of Spanish hospitality. Here, nature, history and exceptional service come together to create an inspiring environment for both our guests and our people. Join our team and become part of the story of Formentor — a place where careers are shaped by meaningful experiences, genuine connections and the opportunity to deliver the exceptional, every day.

**About the Role** 
***Reports to: Director of PR & Marketing***
----------------------------------------------------------------

Supports The PR & Marketing Director in developing and executing public relations and marketing initiatives for the hotel.

In conjugation with Commercial Director, Director of PR & Marketing, the PR & Marketing Assistant Manager plays an integral role in the development and execution of the annual strategic commercial plan comprised of public relations, social media, and marketing communications strategies that support the business objectives. The role also require the involvement in the F&B and SPA marketing strategy, creating and executing marketing and promotional strategies to attract new clients and retain existing ones.

Executes all key PR & Marketing initiatives as defined below:

**Strategic planning & performance:**

* Identify and analyze seasonal trends, key moments, priority feeder markets, and target audiences to inform annual marketing and campaign planning.

Secret Media Network is a digital media group focused on recommending perfect plans, discovering great places, sharing things to do, and relevant breaking news in different cities around the world. Our network is composed of Secret London, Secret Chicago, Secret LA, Secret NYC, Secret Sydney, Lisboa Secreta, Paris Secret, Madrid Secreto, Barcelona Secreta, and More!

We are seeking an experienced Editorial Executive to lead the creation of compelling content for our media outlets for our expansion into new markets. Reporting directly to our VP of Media, you will play a pivotal role in managing a growing team of passionate editors, writers, video producers, and social media creatives.

**What You´ll Do**

* Scope of responsibility for the French and Belgian markets.
* 1-on-1 management, ensuring clear workflows, and providing individual feedback.
* Crafting, communicating, and executing a creative vision for the entire Secret Media Network.
* Collaborating with Editors, Staff Writers, and the video and social team to establish and maintain high editorial standards, adhering to the brand's identity and tone of voice.
* Leading and guiding the team to foster growth, inspire creativity, and reach new audiences.
* Working with experienced editors to elevate our content in established cities, with an eye toward expandable formats.
* Analyzing data for cities in your region based on SMN's internal KPIs, and leveraging findings to inform future strategy.
* Identifying editorial partnership opportunities to broaden SMN content to a diverse audience.
* Taking a hands-on approach to initiate key content-creation initiatives.
* You will also be responsible for coordinating, assigning, and prioritizing editorial work within the team, collaborating with other Fever departments, and developing and analyzing audience-growth strategies. Your role will involve celebrating 'wins' and sharing best practices network-wide.
* Having a deep understanding of how the business operates and translating that knowledge into content strategies that support revenue, audience growth, and overall company objectives.
* Building and optimizing a successful content-driven conversion funnel, ensuring that storytelling, formats, distribution, and audience insights work together to drive measurable conversions.

**Who You Are**

* Proficiency in English and bilingual/native level in French.
* +5 years of experience working for a newsroom, content agency, creative agency, or digital media property.
* Strong leadership skills with a minimum of 2 years of team management experience.
* Deep passion for journalism, especially at the local level, social media, and digital marketing.
* Expertise in media mapping and the ability to collaborate with external partners (advertising agencies, media agencies, TV/Animation companies).
* Digital fluency and hands-on knowledge of the current social media landscape, including platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, etc.
* Ability to inspire creative teams and customers, strong presentation skills.
* Data-driven and business-savvy with superb writing skills and creative flair.
* Solid understanding of optimization technologies and AI-driven processes, workflow automation, and performance outcomes.
* Ability to convert content creators' economy into growth opportunities.
* Team player attitude.
* Additionally, proficiency in using WordPress, familiarity with Photoshop, Canva, and knowledge of other image/video editing software is preferred. Powerful media network contacts and connections will be highly appreciated.

**Why You´ll Love It Here**

* Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Flexible remuneration with Cobee: meals, transport, training, and nursery support (tax-exempt).
* Payflow: option to access part of your salary in advance.
* Taxdown: help optimizing and filing your taxes.
* Private health & dental insurance with Cigna: 100% covered by Fever. You can also add your family members via flexible remuneration.
* Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan.
* Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
* Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Madrid office location.
* Snacks, drinks, and fresh fruit are always available at the office.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

**Company Description**

The primary purpose of the AI Specialist role is to run the mechanics of the path from idea to measured outcome. By operating the AI use-case intake, gathering requirements and mapping processes, maintaining the backlog and delivery cadence, coordinating releases and go-live readiness, and producing the portfolio and benefits reporting, this role delivers a portfolio that is visible, prioritized and measurable, use cases that reach production with an agreed value metric attached, and reporting the AI Council can act on. The role is entry level and designed for a high-potential internal candidate and carries a defined development path.

 **Job Description**

**Responsibilities**

1. Operate the AI Use-Case Intake: log, triage to the correct lane, and prepare requests for prioritization (20%)

2. Requirements Gathering, Process Mapping and Use-Case Documentation (20%)

3. Backlog Management, Delivery Cadence and Sprint Coordination with the engineering team (20%)

4. Portfolio, Adoption and Benefits Reporting for the AI Council, prepared with the Head of Data & AI (15%)

5. Release Coordination and Go-Live Readiness, including user documentation and handover (10%)

6. Stakeholder Liaison with business functions and spoke AI Leads, at working level (10%)

7. Community of Practice and Enablement Support, with the AI literacy owner in HR (5%)  
  
**Competencies & skills requirements**  
  
Analytical Thinking and Structured Problem-Solving

* Competency: Strong analytical ability and structured thinking; the core requirement for this seat, in place of a long delivery track record.
* Skill: Ability to break an ambiguous business request into a defined problem, a scope, and a measurable outcome, and to show the reasoning.
* Application: Ability to turn the requests arriving at the AI Centre of Excellence into documented, comparable use cases that can be scored on value, feasibility and risk.

Requirements and Process Analysis

  

* Competency: Understanding of business analysis fundamentals: requirements elicitation, process mapping and acceptance criteria.
* Skill: Ability to interview business users, document a current-state process, and specify what a solution must do without pre-supposing how it will be built.
* Application: Ability to produce the requirement and process documentation that fusion squads and partner engineers build from, so that scope is understood before work starts.

Delivery Coordination and Agile Ways of Working

* Competency: Understanding of Agile delivery, backlog management and iterative release.
* Skill: Ability to maintain a backlog, run a sprint cadence, track dependencies and keep a delivery plan honest and current.
* Application: Ability to keep the AI delivery cadence predictable and visible, and to escalate slippage early rather than reporting it late.

Communication and Working-Level Stakeholder Management

  

* Competency: Clear written and verbal communication, and the confidence to work across functions as a credible partner.
* Skill: Ability to explain AI capability and its limits in plain language, run a working session, and write documentation people actually read.
* Application: Ability to hold the day-to-day relationship with business functions and spoke AI Leads, escalating executive-level negotiation to the Head of Data & AI rather than attempting it alone.

Value Measurement and Reporting

* Competency: Understanding of how benefit is defined, baselined and evidenced, and why adoption is the leading indicator.

AI and Data Literacy

* Application: Ability to hold a technically credible conversation with the Architect and the Senior AI Engineer, and to develop that depth on the job with structured support.

Governance and Data Protection Awareness

* Competency: Awareness that data protection and AI regulation are design inputs, and knowledge of when to stop and ask.
* Skill: Working understanding of GDPR and of RHG's AI intake and guardrails; the judgement to route a use case to Legal, the Data Protection Officer or Security rather than proceeding.
* Application: Ability to triage requests to the correct lane and risk tier, and to flag governance questions early enough that they do not become late-stage blockers.

Learning Agility, Ownership and Resilience

* Competency: High learning agility and genuine ownership; the attributes that make a development seat succeed or fail.
* Skill: Demonstrated ability to take on unfamiliar work, ask for help early, act on feedback, and follow through without being chased.

title: Senior MEAL Manager
description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**Program Brief**

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solution driven, passionate changemaker, come join us positively impacting the lives of millions of people worldwide for a better future.

Since 2017, IRC has supported Rohingya Refugees and Bangladeshi nationalities communities in Cox's Bazar, Khulna, Barisal, and Chittagong with integrated services. The organization also addresses climate change impacts by building resilience and promoting economic recovery, education, and protection.

**Purpose of the role:**

The Senior MEAL Manager leads all MEAL work for the consortium. This is a full-time, hands-on role in the Program Management Unit (PMU), which manages day-to-day delivery of the project.

In this role, the post holder will:

* Set the MEAL framework and standards for the whole consortium.
* Collect, check and combine indicator data from IRC and all Bangladeshi Partners.
* Make sure DFAT-funded results are clearly attributed and that each client is counted only once.
* Build the MEAL skills of partner organizations.

Partners differ widely in capacity and resources, so the role works with a good degree of independence day to day. The aim is high-quality results, not just compliance. The post holder is supported by the Assessment and Learning (A&L) Manager, the Management Information System (MIS) Manager and IRC sector MEAL Managers and receives technical oversight from the Head of MEAL & Program Quality.

**Work Location:** IRC Bangladesh, Cox’s Bazar Office

**Contract Length:** 31st October 2027 (with possibility of extension subject to funding, program needs and performance of incumbent)

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Consortium MEAL framework and strategic ownership:**

* Design, maintain and regularly update the consortium-wide MEAL framework and MEAL Plan, including the Program Logic, log frame, MEL framework, Performance Indicator Reference Sheets (PIRS) and Indicator Tracking Table (ITT), in line with DFAT’s Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards (February 2026) and Development Evaluation Policy (2026), IRC MEAL policies and IRC’s global strategy, Strategy100. Ensure the framework, MEAL Plan, PIRS and standardized tools are approved and used by all partners.
* Own the consortium’s MEAL standard and practice. Contextualize existing IRC tools, standards and MEAL systems for the consortium rather than building parallel systems. Lead the standard MEAL methods, tools and reporting system, and strengthen partners’ capacity to use them.
* Agree with all partners how each indicator is defined and calculated, what data is collected, which tools are used, how often and with what sampling, and who is responsible. Ensure every partner applies the same definitions and protocols and understands the PIRS.
* Lead the annual Program Logic review and monitoring of key assumptions and risks with partners and contribute monitoring evidence to the consortium risk register.

**Data collection, consolidation, analysis and reporting:**

* Collect, clean, validate, analyze and compile project data for all indicators across IRC and all Bangladeshi Partners, for both monitoring and reporting.
* Ensure all partners collect data using CommCare-based tools and upload it daily to one central server and check the data routinely on dashboards.
* Maintain one common ITT for all partners (used for annual reporting) and analyze CommCare MIS data and the Program Indicator Dashboard (PID) monthly to assess progress and identify priority areas for targeted monitoring. Update the ITT and performance dashboards every month.
* Ensure data is consistently broken down by sex, age, gender, disability and location on every record (using the Washington Group Short Set on Functioning to identify persons with disabilities), and clear attribution of DFAT-funded results through project-specific codes in the MIS, addressing any attribution gaps through agreed data-sharing protocols and monthly data quality reviews.
* Apply DFAT’s unique client counting approach across all partners, using the program-specific client identifier in CommCare to count each individual once at service, sector and program level, and report unique reach against the target of 210,841 individuals by sector, sex, age, gender and disability. Ensure program data reported to DFAT is accurate, complete and donor compliant.
* Set and enforce common data management rules for all partners, covering file naming, storage, version control and data sharing.
* Ensure sensitive GBV and child protection case data remain within GBVIMS+ and CPIMS+ and agreed information-sharing protocols, with only aggregated, anonymized data used in consortium and DFAT reporting.
* Run routine consortium-wide analysis to identify programmatic, geographic, thematic and capacity gaps, including gaps in reaching the most at-risk groups (women and girls, children, adolescents and persons with disabilities) in line with JRP Priority 1 criteria, and flag them promptly to the PMU, outside the regular reporting cycle were urgent.
* Develop and monitor Value for Money (VfM) indicators aligned with DFAT’s 4Es framework (economy, efficiency, effectiveness and equity), including cost per client, cost per output and service utilization rates, working with Finance and sector leads and comparing results across delivery models and against sector benchmarks, and review the results with partners at program performance reviews.
* Prepare quarterly narrative and monitoring reports in consortium-agreed formats, and the MEAL inputs for DFAT annual performance reporting (led by the Program Coordinator, in the 8+3 format and aligned with DFAT’s whole-of-program indicators), with dashboards developed together with the MIS Manager. Submit reports on time and provide the DFAT inputs on schedule.

**Routine and process monitoring:**

* Lead a standardized process monitoring approach with tools and checklists for health and nutrition, protection, child protection and GBV, WASH, education, livelihoods, and emergency preparedness and response, covering quality, whether services are delivered as designed, inclusiveness, timeliness and the functioning of cross-sectoral referral pathways, with safeguarding, AAP and GEDSI built in.
* Monitor service quality, continuity, client access and satisfaction during the phased transition of services to Bangladeshi Partners, in line with the Partner Capacity building and Handover Plan, and report findings and corrective actions to the PMU and DFAT.
* Select activities for monthly spot checks based on MIS analysis (geographic coverage, program component, data quality performance and risk), and conduct spot checks with partner MEAL staff using digital tools.
* Plan and lead joint field visits with sector teams and partners, so that teams learn from one another (proposed monthly, and a longer 2–3 day visit each quarter covering all partners’ project areas).
* Review monitoring findings monthly with sector leads, and present consolidated findings at quarterly Program Performance Review and Reflection meetings, tracking agreed corrective actions to completion.

**Data quality assurance:**

* Check the quality of partner-reported data by verifying it, applying validation rules, cleaning it with a clear record of changes, and giving partners feedback.
* Lead annual Data Quality Assessments (DQAs) using IRC’s DQA methodology, adapted to DFAT’s Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards, and ensure at least 10% of reported data is verified against source documents each quarter during field visits.
* Lead on-site data verification and routine spot checks of CommCare records against registers, attendance sheets and case files (verifying sensitive GBV and child protection records only through agreed confidential protocols).
* Follow up DQA findings with agreed corrective actions and track them to completion and ensure compliance with IRC’s Data Quality Management Framework.

**Baseline, surveys, evaluations and research:**

* Use the baseline survey (completed in November 2026) as the benchmark for tracking change and refining targets, lead the internally managed outcome surveys (including the Year 2 midline) in line with the PIRS collection frequencies, coordinate the independent external endline survey in Year 3, and provide technical coordination of the Joint Program Review at around Month 18 (including the evaluation questions, validation workshop and joint action-planning workshop). Deliver all survey, review and evaluation activities on schedule.
* Develop Terms of Reference, methodologies, sampling plans (95% confidence level, 5% margin of error), tools and analysis plans, and oversee enumerators (IRC-enrolled incentive workers) and partner field supervisors, including daily data checks through dashboards, and ensure enumerators are trained in research ethics, safeguarding, PSEA, informed consent and sensitive-topic data collection.
* Prepare the Scope of Work in consultation with DFAT and share it before the evaluation team is recruited; procure and manage the independent final evaluation to DFAT’s quality and ethical standards and coordinate the management response and action plan and the learning workshop.
* Facilitate research as relevant to DFAT, such as KAP and SMART surveys, outcome harvesting, formative and multisector research, and coordinate with the protection and GEDSI teams so that the program-wide GEDSI analysis and protection analyses inform targeting and adaptation.
* Coordinate methodologies and reporting with DFAT’s external MEL provider.

**Accountability to affected populations:**

* Ensure there is one consortium-wide Client Feedback and Response Mechanism (CFRM) and coordinate it, building on existing partner systems, with safe, accessible and inclusive channels (adapted for persons with disabilities, women with restricted mobility, children and non-literate community members).
* Ensure feedback is recorded in the CommCare MIS and handled through IRC’s 4R approach (Receive, Refer, Respond, Reply), and that communities are told what action was taken.
* Ensure sensitive complaints, including safeguarding, PSEA and misconduct concerns, are referred immediately through safe, confidential pathways to IRC’s Ethics and Compliance Unit and are reported only in aggregate.
* Align CFRM complaint categories with the Common Feedback Platform (CFP) harmonized referral standards, coordinate with CFP focal points and inter-agency accountability mechanisms and refer out-of-scope concerns appropriately.
* Analyze feedback trends together with monitoring data, including signs of inclusion or exclusion errors in targeting, and work with the Community Mobilization, Community Engagement & AAP CoP so findings lead to changes in the program.
* Lead the annual multi-sectoral client satisfaction survey and ensure child-friendly and inclusive feedback methods capture the views of women, girls, boys, older persons and persons with disabilities.

**Learning and adaptive management:**

* Develop and maintain the consortium Learning Agenda (finalized with DFAT and partners) and learning logs and facilitate evidence-to-action processes so findings lead to program changes, including evidence-to-action briefs shared with DFAT, partners and JRP coordination platforms.
* Organize the quarterly reflection sessions, annual learning workshop and the Evidence-to-Action Plan following the Joint Program Review.
* Document and share learning briefs, case studies and good practices with partners, DFAT, other CoPs and IRC technical networks, working with the Communications team.
* Promote Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), Value for Money, localization and safeguarding in all MEAL analysis and learning, drawing on the technical leadership of CDD on disability inclusion and Nari Maitree on gender equality and social inclusion.

**Partner MEAL capacity strengthening and localization:**

* Assess partner MEAL capacity, jointly with partners and in step with the joint organizational capacity assessments and develop a tailored capacity strengthening and sharing plan covering data collection, analysis, reporting and use of data. Implement the plan and document progress.
* Provide training, mentoring, coaching and supportive supervision to partner MEAL staff, and give regular feedback on adherence to agreed tools and standards, while drawing on partners’ own expertise through peer-to-peer, bi-directional capacity sharing.
* Support the gradual handover of MEAL systems, tools and decision-making to Bangladeshi Partners, consistent with the localization-first approach and the Partner capacity building and handover plan.
* Track and report the program’s localization indicators, including the share of funding passed to Bangladeshi Partners and partner leadership of MEAL functions.

**MEAL Community of Practice:**

* Manage the MEAL CoP, which brings together MEAL focal points from IRC and all partners to harmonize tools, review data quality and share learning, guided by one Learning Agenda, and lead its work, with technical support from the Head of MEAL & Program Quality and in coordination with the NGO Forum MEAL Manager (co-lead).
* Prepare the Learning Agenda and meeting agendas, run peer learning sessions, technical clinics, joint problem-solving and peer reviews, and hold the monthly informal sharing meeting and quarterly formal meeting.
* Maintain the shared repository of MEAL tools and learning products and the common action tracker and escalate matters needing management decisions to the PMU.

**Coordination and representation:**

* Represent consortium MEAL directly to DFAT, and present key monitoring and feedback findings to the PMU and, where relevant, the CPF, using aggregate data only (never individual client information) and including community feedback and the changes made in response, which is a standing CPF agenda item.
* Work with the Head of MEAL & Program Quality, Program Coordinator, A&L Manager, MIS Manager, sector MEAL Managers and the NGO Forum MEAL Manager as set out above.
* Represent IRC in inter-agency MEAL, information management, accountability and assessment working groups as required.

**Others:**

* Promote and actively participate in initiatives and efforts to build team engagement, inclusion and cohesion in IRC [team/office]
* Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue and reflection to strengthen safeguarding and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies.

**Key Working Relationships:**

**Position Reports To:** Head of MEAL & Program Quality

**Internal:** MIS Manager, IRC sector MEAL Managers, NGO Forum MEAL Manager, Related CoPs

**External:** Partner MEAL focal points (Nari Maitree, Breaking the Silence, CDD, FIVDB and CNRS), DFAT and its external MEL provider

**Experience:**

* Minimum 7 years of progressive MEAL experience in humanitarian and development settings, including at least 3 years in senior or lead roles managing MEAL systems for multi-partner programs.

**Knowledge, Skills & Competences:**

* Demonstrated experience in strengthening MEAL capacity of local and national partner organizations, and in localization approaches.
* Experience with DFAT (including its Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards and Value for Money framework) or comparable institutional donor requirements (for example US Government, ECHO or OCHA) for compliance, reporting and indicator measurement.
* Experience in at least three of the following sectors: protection, health, WASH, education, GBV, livelihoods and resilience, in humanitarian settings.
* Experience leading baselines, surveys, evaluations and research studies.
* Experience designing and managing multi-partner data systems, including unique client counting and de-duplication, and client feedback and response mechanisms in humanitarian settings.
* Advanced skills in Excel, Power BI, SPSS, Kobo and CommCare; PowerApps and DHIS2 desirable.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analysis skills, and experience developing dashboards and automated reporting systems.
* Knowledge of data protection, safeguarding, protection from sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA), GEDSI and accountability principles, including the ethical handling of sensitive GBV and child protection data.
* GIS/QGIS skills are highly desirable.
* Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions with partners at different capacity levels.
* Strong coaching, facilitation and collaboration skills, with a partner-led and respectful approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bangla.
* Female Candidates are highly encouraged to apply.

**Specific Educational Qualification:**

* Master’s degree preferred in statistics, sociology, public health, development studies, economics, social sciences, demography, monitoring and evaluation, or a related field; or minimum bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with additional relevant experience.

**Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

title: Catastrophe Risk Analyst
description:
**Location** Madrid, Spain **Job type** Full-Time **Work mode** Hybrid **Job level** Professional **Job ID** 14751 **Company** Munich Re Specialty - Global Markets **Employment type** Regular **Area of expertise** Claims & Underwriting

  

**About us**

At Munich Re Specialty – Global Markets (MRS-GM), it is our ambition to become the leading Primary Specialty Insurance provider, underpinned by an effective and adaptable strategy, superior products and industry leaders working in a supportive environment to achieve this.

At the heart of our success is a strong culture where people are encouraged to be present, bold and curious, allowing them to achieve their individual goals.

Please see our website for more information.

**Catastrophe Risk Analyst**

We are currently looking for a Catastrophe Risk Analyst to be based in Madrid on a full-time basis, reporting into the Head of Exposure Management

To provide exposure management and catastrophe risk analytical support to the Exposure Management and Underwriting teams, delivering high-quality risk insights to support underwriting and portfolio management decisions. The role is responsible for the collection, assessment, analysis and reporting of exposure management information, including both regular reporting and ad hoc analytical support for the Syndicate and its international distribution network.

The position will play a key role in establishing and developing an Exposure Management capability in Spain to support the growth of Munich Re Specialty Global Markets across Europe. Working within a developing function, the successful candidate will help shape processes, operating models and analytical capabilities while partnering with senior underwriting and risk stakeholders to support future regional growth.

**Responsibilities**:

* Analyse and manage large and complex datasets, utilising catastrophe and accumulation modelling tools to assess, quantify and communicate catastrophe and accumulation risk across the portfolio.
* Support the development and enhancement of data ingestion, transformation and quality control processes to improve the efficiency and accuracy of catastrophe modelling workflows.
* Interpret, synthesise and present catastrophe model outputs to underwriting teams, including analysis of portfolio changes, model movements and key risk drivers.
* Operate catastrophe modelling platforms and interrogate exposure and results databases using SQL and other analytical tools.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Exposure Management practices through process optimisation, automation and the development of new analytical capabilities.
* Support the design and implementation of operational workflows, controls and governance processes for the European Exposure Management function.
* Assist the Head of Exposure Management in building and developing a high-performing Exposure Management team to support future regional growth.
* Develop innovative analytical solutions to help underwriting teams better understand, quantify and manage catastrophe risk.
* Assess and monitor exposures throughout the underwriting lifecycle, from data receipt and validation through to modelling, analysis and reporting.
* Support post-event analytics and loss estimation activities for both natural and non-natural catastrophe events.
* Assist in the validation, benchmarking and review of third-party catastrophe models and associated modelling assumptions.

**Knowledge and Skills**

* 2+ years' experience in a catastrophe risk, exposure management, actuarial or related analytical role.
* Degree in a quantitative, scientific or hazard-related discipline, such as Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Meteorology, Seismology, Atmospheric Science, Geography or Environmental Science. Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.
* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, with the ability to take ownership, establish new processes and contribute to the development of a growing function.
* Strong analytical and data manipulation skills, with the ability to interpret and communicate complex datasets and modelling results.
* Experience with catastrophe modelling platforms, preferably Moody's RMS solutions, including RiskLink, Risk Modeller, IRP, UWIQ and/or EIQ.
* Experience with alternative catastrophe modelling platforms would be advantageous.
* Familiarity with local reporting requirements and catastrophe risk management frameworks is desirable.
* Experience supporting catastrophe event response activities, hazard monitoring and post-event reporting.
* Proficiency in SQL and Microsoft Excel; experience with Python, R, Power BI or similar analytical or programming tools would be beneficial.
* Fluency in **English and Spanish**; additional European languages (e.g. German or Italian) are a plus.

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align perfectly with everything outlined, or you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the candidate we are looking for!

At Munich Re, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion foster innovation and resilience and enable us to act braver and better. Embracing the power of DEI is at the core of who we are. Reporting to the Head of Shared Delivery & Services, you will serve as the central point of contact for Service Reliability across DT and partner closely with ARTs, Operations, Engineering, Product Management, Risk & Compliance, and senior leadership. governance.

**YOUR CHALLENGE**

title: Head of Pricing and Price-to-market
description:
Allianz Partners is seeking a globally-minded pricing leader to architect the future of RSA (Roadside Asisstance) pricing. This is a strategic, high-visibility role combining deep technical pricing expertise with innovation leadership to drive profitable growth across RSA Lines of Business worldwide.
  
Working hand-in-hand with a dedicated RSA Data team that owns reporting and harmonized portfolio monitoring, your mandate is squarely focused on pricing intelligence: building state-of-the-art rating engines, advancing modelling techniques, connecting external data ecosystems, and setting the technical direction for how Allianz Partners prices RSA risk globally.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
PRICING STRATEGY MARKET POSITIONING
  
  

* Define and own the global pricing strategy for all RSA products, translating portfolio intelligence and market dynamics into competitive, technically sound tariffs across all geographies.
* Conduct rigorous technical competitor analysis (benchmarking RSA rate levels, product structures, and pricing tools against market peers) to sharpen price-to-market positioning.
* Collaborate with Regional Underwriting Portfolio Management teams to ensure pricing strategy is aligned with underwriting appetite, profitability targets, and commercial objectives.
* Support the planning process and RSA Smart Circle Meetings: contribute the pricing perspective to 360-degree quarterly reviews for top B-Partners, translating technical outputs into forward-looking commercial narratives.
* Drive profitable growth by identifying under- and over-priced segments, recommending corrective pricing actions, and monitoring their impact on portfolio KPIs.

RATING ENGINE DEVELOPMENT ADVANCED MODELLING
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end design and evolution of RSA rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, and comparable actuarial platforms, ensuring models are robust, scalable, and regulator-ready.
* Apply advanced statistical and machine-learning techniques (GLMs, GBMs, Random Forests, neural networks, and clustering methods) to frequency/severity modelling, risk segmentation, and rate relativities.
* Implement profit testing frameworks to validate tariff adequacy across the full PL, including claims, expenses, reinsurance costs, and required margin.
* Ensure all rating models are version-controlled, documented, and peer-reviewed, maintaining a high standard of actuarial governance across global markets.

EXTERNAL DATA, CONNECTED PLATFORMS ECOSYSTEM INNOVATION
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and integrate external data sources (telematics, geo-spatial and climate risk data, socio-demographic datasets, medical cost indices, and third-party claims benchmarks) to enrich RSA pricing models.
* Explore and assess AI-driven pricing ecosystems and next-generation actuarial platforms developing a prioritised technology roadmap for RSA pricing infrastructure.
* Collaborate with the RSA Data team to define data requirements and ensure pricing-relevant data pipelines are fit-for-purpose, timely, and of sufficient granularity for advanced modelling.
* Champion the use of open-source and cloud-native modelling tools (Python, R, cloud ML platforms) alongside vendor solutions, building a flexible and future-proof pricing tech stack.
* Evaluate connected insurance concepts (IoT, real-time risk scoring, and embedded pricing APIs) and assess their applicability within the RSA product and distribution landscape.

TARIFF IMPLEMENTATION PRICING GOVERNANCE
  
  

* Manage the full tariff lifecycle: data collection and harmonisation, actuarial modelling, final rate preparation, system testing, and sign-off, ensuring consistent implementation across all available pricing tools and markets.
* Define pricing governance standards, model validation protocols, and change management processes to ensure pricing decisions are transparent, reproducible, and commercially justified.
* Establish a global tariff review calendar aligned with portfolio performance cycles and market conditions, enabling proactive rather than reactive pricing management.
* Work with IT, Operations, and regional teams to ensure seamless deployment of updated rates into policy administration and quoting systems.

TEAM LEADERSHIP CAPABILITY BUILDING
  
  

* Lead, inspire, and grow a team of pricing professionals across global markets, setting clear objectives, providing structured feedback, and creating pathways for professional development.
* Build internal capability in advanced modelling techniques, external data utilisation, and pricing technology tools running knowledge-sharing sessions and supporting technical upskilling.
* Foster a high-performance pricing culture grounded in analytical rigour, intellectual curiosity, commercial awareness, and a drive for continuous innovation.
* Identify and develop talent within the team; support succession planning aligned with Allianz Partners' people strategy and the RSA pricing function's long-term growth.

What you will bring
  
  
EXPERIENCE BACKGROUND
  
  

* 10+ years in pricing, actuarial, or underwriting roles with deep expertise in PC or assistance/travel insurance pricing.
* Minimum 3 years leading a pricing function, with direct management of international teams of 5+ FTEs.
* Proven hands-on experience building and deploying rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, or comparable GLM/ML actuarial platforms.
* Demonstrated track record integrating external data sources and third-party platforms into pricing models in a production environment.
* Experience presenting pricing strategy and modelling outcomes to CRO, CFO, or Board-level stakeholders.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage given the global scope.

TECHNICAL MODELLING SKILLS
  
  

* Expert-level command of GLM-based rating engine development; proficiency in GBMs, Random Forests, and other ML techniques applied to insurance pricing.
* Hands-on with WTW Radar and/or Emblem for rate relativities, model fitting, and scenario testing.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or R for pricing analytics, model automation, and data manipulation.
* Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI) and their application to insurance pricing pipelines.
* Experience with external data integration: geo-spatial data (e.g., Verisk, CoreLogic), medical cost databases, telematics feeds, open weather/climate APIs, and socio-demographic enrichment layers.
* Knowledge of pricing optimisation and elasticity modelling techniques, including demand modelling and customer lifetime value frameworks.
* Solid grounding in actuarial concepts: profit testing, reserving, reinsurance structures, and PL interpretation (GWP, NEP, loss ratio, CoR).

EDUCATION
  
  

* Degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Actuarial qualification or progress toward one (FIA, FCAS, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.

What we offer
  
  
Our employees play an integral part in our success as a business. We appreciate that each of our employees are unique and have unique needs, ambitions and we enjoy being a part of their journey. We are there to empower and encourage you with your personal and professional development ensuring that you take control by offering a large variety of courses and targeted development programs. title: Media Director
description:
**We are Wiser,** a global, award-winning Employer Brand agency.

We build employer brands to guide the best in the biz into their dream career with our clients.  
We’re a home for people who think big and expect more. We transform a company’s employer brand internally and externally and change cultures from the ground up.
  
  
With creative, strategic and early talent experts in-house, our clients have a single partnership with Wiser and we deliver end to end campaigns helping them to attract and retain the best talent globally.  
  
We believe that people will do their best work when they're in a space that enables it. And that's what we've shaped at Wiser - a culture where everyone can be real and back themselves, surrounded by high performers who take ownership of their career and make moves, no matter what their background.  
  
To find out more about us, take a look at our website wearewiser.com
  
or check us out on Instagram @wearewiser.

**WHAT'S THIS ROLE ALL ABOUT?**

At Wiser, we’re redefining how employer brand recruitment marketing campaigns are run. We’re looking for a Media Director to take ownership of media strategy, performance and optimisation across some of our biggest global accounts, with a particular focus on one of our largest US based clients who we run employer and corporate brand campaigns and social channels for.

You’ll be responsible for campaign strategies, media activation, partner management, and performance reporting, ensuring everything we deliver is innovative, insight-led, and impactful. This role is equal parts strategy, analysis and execution. You'll be our subject matter expert in paid media, using your technical expertise and understanding of data to challenge assumptions, identify opportunities and ensure every campaign is delivering against its objectives.

Around 75% of your time will be dedicated to a major US account, where you'll take ownership of media performance, working closely with our Key Account and Campaign teams to translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations. The remaining 25% will focus on supporting our wider portfolio, improving how we approach media strategy, measurement and optimisation across the business.

This role is for a proven media specialist, someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-performance environments, is confident navigating complex datasets and knows how to turn insights into meaningful commercial and campaign outcomes.

**WHAT WILL YOU SPEND YOUR TIME DOING?**

* Owning media strategy and performance for one of our largest US accounts, acting as the senior media expert responsible for campaign effectiveness, optimisation and delivering measurable results.
* Owning campaign strategy and activation, overseeing media planning, buying, execution, optimisation, and reporting, ensuring all campaigns are insight-driven, high-performing, and results-focused.
* Getting under the skin of campaign data, interrogating performance across platforms, identifying trends, spotting inefficiencies and translating complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Developing sophisticated measurement and reporting frameworks, ensuring we're tracking the right metrics, understanding attribution and demonstrating the impact of media investment against client objectives.
* Acting as a trusted senior media partner to our US client, confidently presenting performance insights, challenging existing approaches and making evidence-led recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Bringing technical expertise to the wider Campaigns team, supporting colleagues with complex media challenges, sharing best practice and raising the standard of data analysis, reporting and optimisation across the function.
* Continuously testing and refining our approach, identifying opportunities for experimentation across audiences, channels, creative and targeting strategies to improve performance.
* Working with teams across the business, operating side by side with Creative, Key Accounts and Research & Strategy to make sure campaigns are seamlessly integrated, driving a one-team mindset that delivers the best results for clients and for Wiser.

**WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?**

* A proven expert in media and campaigns, with significant agency-side experience across digital and paid channels, media strategy, planning, buying, optimisation, and analytics.
* An exceptional analytical thinker, comfortable working with large and complex datasets, identifying performance trends and translating data into tangible recommendations.

  + Proven experience with GA4
* Deep technical expertise across digital and social media platforms, with a comprehensive understanding of campaign structures, tracking, attribution, audience segmentation and optimisation.

  + Meta (Insta, FB + Threads), LinkedIn, YouTube + TikTok
  + Nice to have: X, Reddit
  + Ideal would be someone who’s used the above, and practiced experience with cross-platform management tools, such as Sprinklr.
  + Familiar with conversion tracking and attribution
* Strong experience in performance measurement and analytics, with the ability to build reporting frameworks, interrogate campaign effectiveness and demonstrate ROI.
* A hands-on operator, equally comfortable developing a sophisticated media strategy as they are getting into the detail of campaign performance and troubleshooting technical challenges.
* A commercially astute media specialist, who understands how to maximise media investment, manage substantial budgets and balance performance objectives with commercial realities.
* A trusted, senior voice in any room, able to lead client presentations, pitches, and problem-solving sessions with gravitas, particularly when communicating complex data and technical recommendations to non-technical stakeholders.
* Someone who thrives on experimentation and continuous improvement, using testing, analysis and emerging technologies to identify new opportunities and challenge established ways of working.

  + Examples of implementing a learning agenda and/or AB testing on behalf of a client
  + Functional understanding of incrementality testing methodologies such as Brand Lift and/or conversion lift studies
* Experience delivering large-scale, multi-channel campaigns for major US clients, with an understanding of the complexities of operating across international markets.
* A collaborative specialist, able to work closely with strategists, creatives and account leads to ensure media insights inform the wider campaign approach.
* Experience in employer branding and recruitment marketing is welcome but not essential, interest and willingness to learn are key.

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?**

* A Happiness team whose role is to make Wiser the best place to work possible. Whether it’s keeping the office stocked up with snacks, sending you a care package when you’re poorly, or planning the next Wiser party, they make the office a much happier place
* A culture calendar full of options - from black tie to sports day, book club or run club, there’s something for everyone.
* We’re pretty proud of the space we have here - from phone booths to walking pads, all the way to a rainforest for focus-time… whatever vibe you need, you can find it here.
* The W breakfast - our Happiness team makes sure everyone starts the day right with a hotel-worthy breakfast spread. Fancy coffee tap and unlimited fizzies on offer too.
* On top of your holiday allowance, the office also closes for up to 2 weeks over the festive period so we can all recharge before coming back in the new year.
* An extra day off on your Birthday.
* Moving House Day - one of life’s most stressful events made easier by an extra day off.
* Work from Anywhere - everyone has a number of days to work from home or wherever they fancy. Whether it’s staying at home to snuggle your cat or working from Greece for a week in the summer, WFA is the answer.
* Therapy - with 5 therapists to choose from, each year you can get up to x3 therapy sessions subsidised through Wiser to take either here in our own secret Log Cabin, externally or online (you pay £20 a session and we cover the rest)
* Vitality Health Insurance - full coverage once you’ve passed probation. From necessities like the dentist, doctors and opticians, to mega rewards like Champneys, gym and travel discounts, it’s a winner.
* Gymbox - once passing probation, you can access our exclusive Wiser x Gymbox partnership where you can bag your Gymbox membership for less than half price.  
    
  Further details available upon interview progression

##### **The Road to Wiser...**

* Apply (Go on... do it)
* Intro call w/ our Head of Talent
* Video call w/ US Business Director
* Task & Tour
* High Performance Offer Deck (HiPOD) w/ our COO Anna.

At Wiser, we’re committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels empowered to be themselves and inspired to excel. We know that true creativity and innovation thrive when diversity is celebrated and everyone is given equal access to opportunities. That’s why we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or socioeconomic status.  
  
We believe that everyone should feel comfortable and be able to back themselves in an inclusive environment where individuality is celebrated. We’re building a team as diverse as the brands we work with, and our aim is to change the way people think about work.  
  
If you’re passionate about making meaningful moves in an environment that’s as inclusive as it is high-performing, we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to Wiser. Feel free to reach out to our Talent Team if you need any adjustments to make our hiring process more accessible.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Oxford Data Plan (ODP) is a SaaS business providing alternative data tracking platforms to institutional investors, including hedge funds and asset managers. In September 2026 ODP was named one of 25 companies in Tech Nation's Future Fifty cohort, the UK programme for high-growth tech scaleups. We operate across the UK, US and UAE, with a growing operations and back-office team in the Philippines. This is a scale-up environment: processes are still being built, and this role will shape many of them.

The Head of Marketing owns how ODP is known, understood and chosen by institutional investors. You will lead the existing marketing team, run a balanced programme across brand, product marketing and demand generation, and make marketing a measurable contributor to pipeline and revenue.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Lead the marketing team**

* Manage, coach and develop the marketing team; set priorities, objectives and performance standards.
* Own the marketing plan and budget, with clear allocation across brand, product marketing and demand generation.
* Own the marketing tech stack (HubSpot, website, analytics): data quality, configuration and adoption.
* Report marketing performance and return on spend to the CRO and leadership team monthly.

**Build the brand and positioning**

* Define and maintain ODP's positioning, messaging and brand standards for institutional investors.
* Own the website, content and thought leadership, including data-led research and insights.
* Grow ODP's profile with hedge funds and asset managers across the UK, US and UAE.
* Manage PR, events and partner relationships where they support the brand.

**Lead product marketing**

* Work with Product, Tech and Data to turn platform capabilities into clear value propositions.
* Lead go-to-market for new products, datasets and features, from launch plan to sales enablement.
* Produce sales collateral, case studies and competitive intelligence.
* Feed customer and market insight into the product roadmap.

**Drive demand generation and pipeline**

* Agree pipeline targets with the CRO and own marketing's contribution to them.
* Plan and run multi-channel campaigns: email, content, events, paid and account-based marketing.
* Agree lead management with Sales: scoring, routing, handoff SLAs and follow-up.
* Track funnel conversion and attribution, and move spend to what works.

**Skills and experience**
-------------------------

**Essential**

* 7+ years in B2B marketing, including 2+ years managing a team.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS or subscription business.
* Track record across brand, product marketing and demand generation, with measurable pipeline impact.
* Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform and CRM.

* Strong writer who can explain technical data products to sophisticated buyers.
* Clear, direct communicator who can work with senior leaders and hands-on team members alike.

**Desirable**

* Experience marketing data or fintech products to financial services and institutional investors.
* Exposure to scale-up growth stages, fundraising or investor due diligence.
* Account-based marketing and events experience in UK and US markets.
* Familiarity with automation tools (e.g. Zapier) and website CMS platforms.

title: Director, Marketing
description:

title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
description:
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.

Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
* Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
* Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
* Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
* Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
* Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
* Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
* Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
* Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
* Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
* Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
* Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
* Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership

This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline
* 15+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission-critical, or large-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role
* Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high-density compute
* Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria
* Hands-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads
* Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission-critical projects
* Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners
* Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred
* Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid-cooled and high-density rack deployments
* Owner-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer
* Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites
* Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes
* Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA
* Experience in a fast-growth owner organization building in-house technical capability

This position may involve duties that require operation of a company vehicle or travel between job sites. As such, candidates must be insurable under CleanSpark's vehicle insurance policy.

CleanSpark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Head of Performance Creative
description:
****Role Objective****
****AtlasBrands is looking for a Head of Performance Creative (Meta) to serve as the "CEO" of our primary acquisition channel.****
Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.
  
  
You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.

* Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
